  501 | // Automated Churn Prediction Model (Logistic-style Probability from Weighted Factors)
  502 | function computeChurnProbability(memberId: string): {
  503 |   probability: number;
  504 |   band: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  505 |   factors: ChurnFactor[];
  506 |   branch_id?: string;
  507 | } {
  508 |   const m = members.find(mem => mem.id === memberId);
  509 |   if (!m || m.is_archived || m.status !== 'active') {
  510 |     return {
  511 |       probability: 0,
  512 |       band: 'low',
  513 |       factors: [],
  514 |       branch_id: m?.branch_id
  515 |     };
  516 |   }
  517 | 
  518 |   const memLogs = attendanceLogs.filter(a => a.member_id === memberId);
  519 |   let lastVisit: Date | null = null;
  520 |   if (memLogs.length > 0) {
  521 |     const sorted = [...memLogs].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.checked_in_at).getTime() - new Date(a.checked_in_at).getTime());
  522 |     lastVisit = new Date(sorted[0].checked_in_at);
  523 |   }
  524 | 
  525 |   const now = new Date();
  526 |   const todayDate = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  527 | 
  528 |   const daysSince = lastVisit
  529 |     ? Math.floor((todayDate.getTime() - new Date(lastVisit.getFullYear(), lastVisit.getMonth(), lastVisit.getDate()).getTime()) / (24 * 3600 * 1000))
  530 |     : 999;
  531 | 
  532 |   let daysLeft = 999;
  533 |   if (m.end_date) {
  534 |     const endDate = new Date(m.end_date);
  535 |     daysLeft = Math.ceil((new Date(endDate.getFullYear(), endDate.getMonth(), endDate.getDate()).getTime() - todayDate.getTime()) / (24 * 3600 * 1000));
  536 |   }
  537 | 
  538 |   const fourteenDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 14 * 24 * 3600 * 1000);
  539 |   const twentyEightDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 28 * 24 * 3600 * 1000);
  540 | 
  541 |   const visits14 = memLogs.filter(a => new Date(a.checked_in_at) >= fourteenDaysAgo).length;
  542 |   const visitsPrev14 = memLogs.filter(a => {
  543 |     const d = new Date(a.checked_in_at);
  544 |     return d >= twentyEightDaysAgo && d < fourteenDaysAgo;
  545 |   }).length;
  546 | 
  547 |   let logit = -2.2; // base prior ~10%
  548 |   const factors: ChurnFactor[] = [];
  549 | 
  550 |   // Feature contributions (log-odds style weights)
  551 |   if (!lastVisit) {
  552 |     logit += 1.40;
  553 |     factors.push({ key: 'never_visited', weight: 1.40 });
  554 |   } else if (daysSince >= 30) {
  555 |     logit += 1.50;
  556 |     factors.push({ key: 'stale_30d', weight: 1.50, days: daysSince });
  557 |   } else if (daysSince >= 21) {
  558 |     logit += 1.10;
  559 |     factors.push({ key: 'stale_21d', weight: 1.10, days: daysSince });
  560 |   } else if (daysSince >= 14) {
  561 |     logit += 0.80;
  562 |     factors.push({ key: 'stale_14d', weight: 0.80, days: daysSince });
  563 |   }
  564 | 
  565 |   if (visitsPrev14 >= 2 && visits14 / visitsPrev14 <= 0.5) {
  566 |     logit += 0.90;
  567 |     factors.push({ key: 'attendance_drop', weight: 0.90 });
  568 |   }
  569 | 
  570 |   if (daysLeft <= 0) {
  571 |     logit += 1.60;
  572 |     factors.push({ key: 'expired', weight: 1.60 });
  573 |   } else if (daysLeft <= 3) {
  574 |     logit += 1.20;
  575 |     factors.push({ key: 'expiring_3d', weight: 1.20, days_left: daysLeft });
  576 |   } else if (daysLeft <= 7) {
  577 |     logit += 0.85;
  578 |     factors.push({ key: 'expiring_7d', weight: 0.85, days_left: daysLeft });
  579 |   }
  580 | 
  581 |   const bal = Number(m.balance_due) || 0;
  582 |   if (bal > 0) {
  583 |     let weight = 0.25;
  584 |     if (bal >= 3000) weight = 0.70;
  585 |     else if (bal >= 1000) weight = 0.45;
  586 |     logit += weight;
  587 |     factors.push({ key: 'dues', weight, amount: bal });
  588 |   }
  589 | 
  590 |   // Sigmoid probability calculation: 1 / (1 + e^-logit)
  591 |   const prob = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-logit));
  592 |   const roundedProb = Math.round(prob * 10000) / 10000;
  593 | 
  594 |   let band: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical' = 'low';
  595 |   if (roundedProb >= 0.75) band = 'critical';
  596 |   else if (roundedProb >= 0.55) band = 'high';
  597 |   else if (roundedProb >= 0.30) band = 'medium';
  598 | 
  599 |   return {
  600 |     probability: roundedProb,
  601 |     band,
  602 |     factors,
  603 |     branch_id: m.branch_id
  604 |   };
  605 | }

  607 | function refreshChurnPredictions(): { updated: number; at: string } {
  608 |   let updatedCount = 0;
  609 |   const activeMembers = members.filter(m => m.status === 'active' && !m.is_archived);
  610 | 
  611 |   for (const m of activeMembers) {
  612 |     const pred = computeChurnProbability(m.id);
  613 |     const existingIndex = memberChurnPredictions.findIndex(p => p.member_id === m.id);
  614 |     const branch = branches.find(b => b.id === (pred.branch_id || m.branch_id));
  615 | 
  616 |     const predObj: MemberChurnPrediction = {
  617 |       member_id: m.id,
  618 |       branch_id: pred.branch_id || m.branch_id,
  619 |       branch_name: branch?.name || m.branch_name,
  620 |       member_name: m.full_name,
  621 |       member_phone: m.phone,
  622 |       member_email: m.email,
  623 |       package_type: m.package_type,
  624 |       end_date: m.end_date,
  625 |       balance_due: m.balance_due,
  626 |       churn_probability: pred.probability,
  627 |       risk_band: pred.band,
  628 |       factors: pred.factors,
  629 |       model_version: 'rules_v1',
  630 |       predicted_at: new Date().toISOString()
  631 |     };
  632 | 
  633 |     if (existingIndex >= 0) {
  634 |       memberChurnPredictions[existingIndex] = predObj;
  635 |     } else {
  636 |       memberChurnPredictions.push(predObj);
  637 |     }
  638 |     updatedCount++;
  639 |   }
  640 | 
  641 |   return { updated: updatedCount, at: new Date().toISOString() };
  642 | }

  669 | // Indian Standard Time (IST UTC+5:30) Silence Hours Check: 21:00 - 08:00
  670 | function inSilenceHoursIST(): boolean {
  671 |   const now = new Date();
  672 |   const utcMs = now.getTime() + (now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000);
  673 |   const istTime = new Date(utcMs + (3600000 * 5.5));
  674 |   const istHour = istTime.getHours();
  675 |   return istHour >= 21 || istHour < 8;
  676 | }

  678 | function phone10(p: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  679 |   const d = String(p || '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10);
  680 |   return d.length === 10 ? d : null;

  683 | // AI Retention Risk Scoring Calculation Engine
  684 | function calculateMemberRisk(
  685 |   member: Member,
  686 |   allAttendance: AttendanceRecord[]
  687 | ): { score: number; level: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'; reasons: string[] } {
  688 |   let score = 0;
  689 |   const reasons: string[] = [];
  690 | 
  691 |   // Filter member attendances
  692 |   const memberVisits = allAttendance
  693 |     .filter((a) => a.member_id === member.id)
  694 |     .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.checked_in_at).getTime() - new Date(a.checked_in_at).getTime());
  695 | 
  696 |   const lastVisit = memberVisits.length > 0 ? new Date(memberVisits[0].checked_in_at) : null;
  697 |   const now = new Date();
  698 | 
  699 |   // Factor 1: Days since last visit
  700 |   if (lastVisit) {
  701 |     const daysSince = Math.floor((now.getTime() - lastVisit.getTime()) / (1000 * 3600 * 24));
  702 |     if (daysSince >= 21) {
  703 |       score += 35;
  704 |       reasons.push(`No gym check-in for ${daysSince} consecutive days`);
  705 |     } else if (daysSince >= 14) {
  706 |       score += 25;
  707 |       reasons.push(`No gym check-in for ${daysSince} days`);
  708 |     } else if (daysSince >= 7) {
  709 |       score += 10;
  710 |       reasons.push(`Absent for ${daysSince} days`);
  711 |     }
  712 |   } else if (member.status === 'active') {
  713 |     score += 30;
  714 |     reasons.push('No recorded check-ins since membership activation');
  715 |   }
  716 | 
  717 |   // Factor 2: Days until membership expiry
  718 |   if (member.end_date) {
  719 |     const endDate = new Date(member.end_date);
  720 |     const daysToExpiry = Math.ceil((endDate.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 3600 * 24));
  721 |     if (daysToExpiry < 0) {
  722 |       score += 35;
  723 |       reasons.push(`Membership expired ${Math.abs(daysToExpiry)} days ago`);
  724 |     } else if (daysToExpiry <= 5) {
  725 |       score += 25;
  726 |       reasons.push(`Membership ends in ${daysToExpiry} days`);
  727 |     } else if (daysToExpiry <= 10) {
  728 |       score += 15;
  729 |       reasons.push(`Membership renewal due in ${daysToExpiry} days`);
  730 |     }
  731 |   }
  732 | 
  733 |   // Factor 3: Outstanding balance due
  734 |   if (member.balance_due && member.balance_due > 0) {
  735 |     score += 15;
  736 |     reasons.push(`Outstanding balance of ₹${member.balance_due.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`);
  737 |   }
  738 | 
  739 |   // Factor 4: Failed Auto-Debit e-mandate
  740 |   if (member.mandate_status === 'failed') {
  741 |     score += 20;
  742 |     reasons.push('UPI Auto-Debit e-mandate transaction failed');
  743 |   }
  744 | 
  745 |   const finalScore = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, score));
  746 |   const level: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' =
  747 |     finalScore >= 70 ? 'high' : finalScore >= 40 ? 'medium' : 'low';
  748 | 
  749 |   return { score: finalScore, level, reasons };
  750 | }

 1647 | /**
 1648 |  * Dynamic Expiry Auto-Sync Helper
 1649 |  */
 1650 | function syncMemberExpiries() {
 1651 |   const todayStr = getTodayStr();
 1652 |   members.forEach(m => {
 1653 |     if (!m.is_archived && m.status === 'active' && m.end_date) {
 1654 |       if (m.end_date < todayStr) {
 1655 |         m.status = 'expired';
 1656 |         m.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
 1657 |       }
 1658 |     }
 1659 |   });
 1660 | }

 1675 | app.get('/api/trainers', (req, res) => {

 1677 |   let list = profiles.filter(p => p.role === 'trainer');
 1678 |   if (branch_id && branch_id !== 'all') {
 1679 |     list = list.filter(p => p.branch_id === branch_id);
 1680 |   }
 1681 |   const enriched = list.map(t => {

 1683 |     return {
 1684 |       ...t,
 1685 |       branch_name: br ? br.name : t.branch_name || 'Pulse Fitness - Nagarabhavi',
 1686 |       branch: br ? { id: br.id, name: br.name, code: br.code, city: br.city } : undefined
 1687 |     };

 1692 | // Members List with Intelligence & Archive Filters
 1693 | app.get('/api/members', (req, res) => {
 1694 |   syncMemberExpiries();
 1695 |   const { filter, trainerId, search, status, includeArchived } = req.query;
 1696 |   let result = [...members];
 1697 | 
 1698 |   // Filter archived members by default unless explicitly requesting archived filter or includeArchived=true
 1699 |   if (filter === 'archived') {
 1700 |     result = result.filter(m => m.is_archived === true);
 1701 |   } else if (includeArchived !== 'true') {
 1702 |     result = result.filter(m => !m.is_archived);
 1703 |   }
 1704 | 
 1705 |   if (status && typeof status === 'string') {
 1706 |     result = result.filter(m => m.status === status);
 1707 |   }
 1708 | 
 1709 |   if (trainerId && typeof trainerId === 'string') {
 1710 |     result = result.filter(m => m.onboarded_by === trainerId);
 1711 |   }
 1712 | 
 1713 |   const today = getTodayStr();
 1714 | 
 1715 |   if (filter === 'today') {
 1716 |     result = result.filter(m => m.start_date === today || m.created_at.startsWith(today));
 1717 |   } else if (filter === 'this_week') {
 1718 |     const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
 1719 |     result = result.filter(m => (m.start_date && m.start_date >= sevenDaysAgo) || m.created_at >= sevenDaysAgo);
 1720 |   } else if (filter === 'pending') {
 1721 |     result = result.filter(m => m.status === 'pending');
 1722 |   } else if (filter === 'active') {
 1723 |     result = result.filter(m => m.status === 'active');
 1724 |   } else if (filter === 'expired') {
 1725 |     result = result.filter(m => m.status === 'expired');
 1726 |   } else if (filter === 'expiring_7') {
 1727 |     const sevenDaysLater = new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
 1728 |     result = result.filter(m => m.status === 'active' && m.end_date && m.end_date >= today && m.end_date <= sevenDaysLater);
 1729 |   } else if (filter === 'expiring_15') {
 1730 |     const fifteenDaysLater = new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
 1731 |     result = result.filter(m => m.status === 'active' && m.end_date && m.end_date >= today && m.end_date <= fifteenDaysLater);
 1732 |   } else if (filter === 'expiring_30') {
 1733 |     const thirtyDaysLater = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
 1734 |     result = result.filter(m => m.status === 'active' && m.end_date && m.end_date >= today && m.end_date <= thirtyDaysLater);
 1735 |   }
 1736 | 
 1737 |   if (search && typeof search === 'string') {
 1738 |     const q = search.toLowerCase().trim();
 1739 |     result = result.filter(m =>
 1740 |       m.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
 1741 |       m.phone.includes(q) ||
 1742 |       (m.email && m.email.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
 1743 |       (m.payment_reference && m.payment_reference.toLowerCase().includes(q))
 1744 |     );
 1745 |   }
 1746 | 
 1747 |   result.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at).getTime());
 1748 |   res.json(result);
 1749 | });

 1786 | // Commission helper: ensures payment row always creates a settlement record for payroll truth
 1787 | function recordCommissionSettlementOnPayment(
 1788 |   paymentId: string,
 1789 |   member: Member,
 1790 |   amountPaid: number,
 1791 |   notes?: string
 1792 | ) {
 1793 |   if (!amountPaid || amountPaid <= 0) return;
 1794 |   const trainerId = member.onboarded_by || 'usr_trainer_1';
 1795 |   const trainer = profiles.find((p) => p.id === trainerId);
 1796 |   const trainerName = trainer ? trainer.full_name : (member.trainer_name || 'Trainer');
 1797 |   const rate = member.commission_rate ?? getDefaultCommissionRate(member.package_type);
 1798 |   const commAmount = calculateCommissionAmount(amountPaid, rate);
 1799 |   if (commAmount <= 0) return;
 1800 | 
 1801 |   const todayStr = getTodayStr();
 1802 |   const periodMonth = `${todayStr.slice(0, 7)}-01`;
 1803 |   const branchId = member.branch_id || 'br_nag_1';
 1804 |   const branch = branches.find((b) => b.id === branchId);
 1805 | 
 1806 |   const settlement: CommissionSettlement = {
 1807 |     id: `set_line_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
 1808 |     trainer_id: trainerId,
 1809 |     trainer_name: trainerName,
 1810 |     member_id: member.id,
 1811 |     member_name: member.full_name,
 1812 |     member_phone: member.phone,
 1813 |     branch_id: branchId,
 1814 |     branch_name: branch ? branch.name : (member.branch_name || 'Pulse Fitness'),
 1815 |     payment_id: paymentId,
 1816 |     amount: commAmount,
 1817 |     rate_percent: rate,
 1818 |     base_amount: amountPaid,
 1819 |     package_type: member.package_type,
 1820 |     period_start: periodMonth,
 1821 |     period_end: todayStr,
 1822 |     period_month: periodMonth,
 1823 |     status: 'pending',
 1824 |     notes: notes || `Commission for ${member.package_type || 'Membership'} (₹${amountPaid})`,
 1825 |     created_at: new Date().toISOString()
 1826 |   };
 1827 | 
 1828 |   commissionSettlements.unshift(settlement);
 1829 | }
 1830 | 
 1831 | // Activate Member Helper
 1832 | function processMemberActivation(targetId: string, payload: any, res: express.Response) {
 1833 |   const {
 1834 |     subscription_months,
 1835 |     p_subscription_months,
 1836 |     package_type,
 1837 |     p_package_type,
 1838 |     payment_method,
 1839 |     p_payment_method,
 1840 |     amount_paid,
 1841 |     p_amount_paid,
 1842 |     balance_due,
 1843 |     p_balance_due,
 1844 |     payment_reference,
 1845 |     p_payment_reference,
 1846 |     commission_rate,
 1847 |     p_commission_rate,
 1848 |     notes,
 1849 |     p_notes,
 1850 |     activated_by,
 1851 |     p_actor_id
 1852 |   } = payload || {};
 1853 | 
 1854 |   const member = members.find(m => m.id === targetId);
 1855 |   if (!member) {
 1856 |     return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Member record not found.' });
 1857 |   }
 1858 | 
 1859 |   const subMonths = subscription_months !== undefined ? subscription_months : p_subscription_months;
 1860 |   const pkgType = package_type || p_package_type;
 1861 |   const payMethod = payment_method || p_payment_method;
 1862 |   const amtPaid = amount_paid !== undefined ? amount_paid : p_amount_paid;
 1863 |   const balDue = balance_due !== undefined ? balance_due : p_balance_due;
 1864 |   const payRef = payment_reference || p_payment_reference;
 1865 |   const commRateInput = commission_rate !== undefined ? commission_rate : p_commission_rate;
 1866 |   const noteText = notes || p_notes;
 1867 |   const actorId = activated_by || p_actor_id;
 1868 | 
 1869 |   const months = subMonths ? parseInt(String(subMonths)) : 1;
 1870 |   const pkg: PlanPackage = pkgType || 'General Gym';
 1871 |   const pkgConfig = PACKAGE_CONFIGS[pkg] || PACKAGE_CONFIGS['General Gym'];
 1872 | 
 1873 |   const today = getTodayStr();
 1874 |   const endDate = addMonthsToDate(today, months);
 1875 | 
 1876 |   const paidVal = amtPaid !== undefined ? parseFloat(String(amtPaid)) : (pkgConfig.pricePerMonth * months);
 1877 |   const dueVal = balDue !== undefined ? parseFloat(String(balDue)) : 0;
 1878 |   const commRate = commRateInput !== undefined ? parseFloat(String(commRateInput)) : pkgConfig.defaultCommissionRate;
 1879 | 
 1880 |   const calculatedCommission = calculateCommissionAmount(paidVal, commRate);
 1881 | 
 1882 |   member.status = 'active';
 1883 |   member.subscription_months = months;
 1884 |   member.package_type = pkg;
 1885 |   member.payment_method = payMethod || 'UPI / GPay / PhonePe';
 1886 |   member.amount_paid = paidVal;
 1887 |   member.balance_due = dueVal;
 1888 |   member.payment_reference = payRef || undefined;
 1889 |   member.commission_rate = commRate;
 1890 |   member.commission_amount = calculatedCommission;
 1891 |   member.start_date = today;
 1892 |   member.end_date = endDate;
 1893 |   if (noteText) {
 1894 |     member.notes = member.notes ? `${member.notes} | ${noteText}` : noteText;
 1895 |   }
 1896 |   member.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
 1897 | 
 1898 |   const payId = `pay_${Date.now()}`;
 1899 |   const activator = profiles.find(p => p.id === actorId) || profiles.find(p => p.id === member.onboarded_by);
 1900 |   paymentHistory.unshift({
 1901 |     id: payId,
 1902 |     member_id: member.id,
 1903 |     amount: paidVal,
 1904 |     payment_method: member.payment_method,

 2755 |       const filePath = path.join(dir, file);
 2756 |       const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
 2757 |       if (stat.isDirectory()) {
 2758 |         if (!['node_modules', 'dist', '.git', '.github', '.vite'].includes(file)) {
 2759 |           getAllFiles(filePath, fileList);
 2760 |         }
 2761 |       } else {
 2762 |         const ext = path.extname(file).toLowerCase();
 2763 |         const base = path.basename(file);
 2764 |         if (
 2765 |           !['.png', '.ico', '.svg', '.jpeg', '.jpg', '.pdf', '.lock'].includes(ext) &&
 2766 |           file !== 'bun.lock' &&
 2767 |           file !== 'package-lock.json' &&
 2768 |           !base.includes('entire-codebase') &&
 2769 |           !base.startsWith('.') &&
 2770 |           !dir.includes('.aistudio')
 2771 |         ) {
 2772 |           fileList.push(filePath);
 2773 |         }
 2774 |       }
 2775 |     }
 2776 |     return fileList;
 2777 |   }
 2778 | 
 2779 |   const allFiles = getAllFiles(rootDir);
 2780 |   const items = allFiles.map((fp, idx) => {
 2781 |     const relPath = path.relative(rootDir, fp).replace(/\\/g, '/');
 2782 |     const stat = fs.statSync(fp);
 2783 |     const content = fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf8');
 2784 |     const lines = content.split('\n');
 2785 |     let category = 'Other';
 2786 |     if (relPath.startsWith('src/components/')) category = 'Components';
 2787 |     else if (relPath.startsWith('src/hooks/')) category = 'Hooks';
 2788 |     else if (relPath.startsWith('src/lib/')) category = 'Business Logic (Lib)';
 2789 |     else if (relPath.startsWith('src/types/')) category = 'TypeScript Types';
 2790 |     else if (relPath === 'server.ts') category = 'Server Backend';
 2791 |     else if (relPath.startsWith('supabase/')) category = 'Database Migrations';
 2792 |     else if (relPath.startsWith('scripts/')) category = 'Scripts';
 2793 |     else if (relPath === 'package.json' || relPath === 'tsconfig.json' || relPath === 'vite.config.ts' || relPath === 'metadata.json') category = 'Configuration';
 2794 | 
 2795 |     return {
 2796 |       index: idx + 1,
 2797 |       path: relPath,
 2798 |       size: stat.size,
 2799 |       linesCount: lines.length,
 2800 |       category
 2801 |     };
 2802 |   });

 4670 |

 4981 | app.get('/api/day-register', (req, res) => {
 4982 |   const { date, branch_id } = req.query;
 4983 |   const targetDate = typeof date === 'string' ? date : getTodayStr();
 4984 | 
 4985 |   // Find all payment records on target date
 4986 |   let dayPayments = paymentHistory.filter(p => {
 4987 |     const pDate = p.entry_date || p.created_at.slice(0, 10);
 4988 |     return pDate === targetDate;
 4989 |   });
 4990 | 
 4991 |   if (branch_id && branch_id !== 'all') {
 4992 |     dayPayments = dayPayments.filter(p => {
 4993 |       if (p.branch_id) return p.branch_id === branch_id;
 4994 |       const mem = members.find(m => m.id === p.member_id);
 4995 |       return mem?.branch_id === branch_id;
 4996 |     });
 4997 |   }
 4998 | 
 4999 |   const entries: DayRegisterEntry[] = dayPayments.map((p, idx) => {
 5000 |     const mem = members.find(m => m.id === p.member_id);
 5001 |     const branch = branches.find(b => b.id === (p.branch_id || mem?.branch_id));
 5002 | 
 5003 |     return {
 5004 |       id: p.id,
 5005 |       row_number: idx + 1,
 5006 |       entry_type: p.entry_type || (mem?.amount_paid === p.amount ? 'new' : 'balance'),
 5007 |       member_id: p.member_id,
 5008 |       full_name: mem?.full_name || 'Member',
 5009 |       phone: mem?.phone || '',
 5010 |       gender: mem?.gender,
 5011 |       months: mem?.subscription_months,
 5012 |       amount: p.amount,
 5013 |       payment_method: p.payment_method,
 5014 |       list_price: p.list_price,
 5015 |       balance_after: p.balance_after !== undefined ? p.balance_after : (mem?.balance_due || 0),
 5016 |       notes: p.notes,
 5017 |       entry_date: p.entry_date || p.created_at.slice(0, 10),
 5018 |       branch_id: p.branch_id || mem?.branch_id,
 5019 |       branch_name: branch?.name || mem?.branch_name,
 5020 |       created_at: p.created_at
 5021 |     };
 5022 |   });
 5023 | 
 5024 |   const totalCollected = entries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.amount, 0);
 5025 |   const upiCollected = entries.filter(e => String(e.payment_method).toLowerCase().includes('upi') || String(e.payment_method).toLowerCase().includes('gpay') || String(e.payment_method).toLowerCase().includes('phonepe')).reduce((s, e) => s + e.amount, 0);
 5026 |   const cashCollected = entries.filter(e => String(e.payment_method).toLowerCase().includes('cash')).reduce((s, e) => s + e.amount, 0);
 5027 |   const cardCollected = entries.filter(e => String(e.payment_method).toLowerCase().includes('card')).reduce((s, e) => s + e.amount, 0);
 5028 |   const bankTransferCollected = totalCollected - (upiCollected + cashCollected + cardCollected);
 5029 | 
 5030 |   const newJoinsCount = entries.filter(e => e.entry_type === 'new').length;
 5031 |   const renewalsCount = entries.filter(e => e.entry_type === 'renewal').length;
 5032 |   const balanceCollectionsCount = entries.filter(e => e.entry_type === 'balance').length;
 5033 | 
 5034 |   const summary: DayRegisterSummary = {
 5035 |     date: targetDate,
 5036 |     total_entries: entries.length,
 5037 |     new_joins_count: newJoinsCount,
 5038 |     renewals_count: renewalsCount,
 5039 |     balance_collections_count: balanceCollectionsCount,
 5040 |     total_collected: totalCollected,
 5041 |     upi_collected: upiCollected,
 5042 |     cash_collected: cashCollected,
 5043 |     card_collected: cardCollected,
 5044 |     bank_transfer_collected: Math.max(0, bankTransferCollected),
 5045 |     total_balance_generated: entries.reduce((s, e) => s + (e.balance_after || 0), 0)
 5046 |   };
 5047 | 
 5048 |   res.json({ date: targetDate, summary, entries });

   64 | /** Typed RPC helper for Activate Member */
   65 | export async function rpcActivateMember(args: ActivateMemberArgs): Promise<ActivateMemberResult> {
   66 |   const res = await fetch('/api/members/activate', {
   67 |     method: 'POST',
   68 |     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   69 |     body: JSON.stringify(args),
   70 |   });
   71 |   const data = await parseResponseJson<any>(res, {});
   72 |   if (!res.ok) {
   73 |     throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to activate member');
   74 |   }
   75 |   return data as ActivateMemberResult;
   76 | }
   77 | 
   78 | /** Typed RPC helper for Bulk Member updates */
   79 | export async function rpcBulkUpdateMembers(args: BulkUpdateMembersArgs): Promise<number> {
   80 |   const res = await fetch('/api/members/bulk-update', {
   81 |     method: 'POST',
   82 |     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   83 |     body: JSON.stringify(args),
   84 |   });
   85 |   const data = await parseResponseJson<any>(res, {});
   86 |   if (!res.ok) {
   87 |     throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to update members');
   88 |   }
   89 |   return typeof data.count === 'number' ? data.count : args.p_member_ids.length;
   90 | }
   91 | 
   92 | /** Typed RPC helper for Payroll Lines */
   93 | export async function rpcGetPayrollLines(args: GetPayrollLinesArgs): Promise<PayrollLine[]> {
   94 |   const params = new URLSearchParams();
   95 |   params.set('period_month', args.p_period_month);
   96 |   if (args.p_branch_id) params.set('branch_id', args.p_branch_id);
   97 |   if (args.p_trainer_id) params.set('trainer_id', args.p_trainer_id);
   98 |   if (args.p_status) params.set('status', args.p_status);
   99 | 
  100 |   const res = await fetch(`/api/payroll/lines?${params.toString()}`);
  101 |   const data = await parseResponseJson<any>(res, {});
  102 |   if (!res.ok) {
  103 |     throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to fetch payroll lines');
  104 |   }
  105 |   return (data.lines || data || []) as PayrollLine[];
  106 | }
  107 | 
  108 | /** Typed RPC helper for Stale Members calculation */
  109 | export async function rpcFlagStaleMembers(args: FlagStaleMembersArgs = {}): Promise<FlagStaleMembersResult> {
  110 |   const res = await fetch('/api/retention/calculate-risk', {
  111 |     method: 'POST',
  112 |     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  113 |     body: JSON.stringify({ days: args.p_days ?? 14 }),
  114 |   });
  115 |   const data = await parseResponseJson<any>(res, {});
  116 |   if (!res.ok) {
  117 |     throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to calculate risk');
  118 |   }
  119 |   return {
  120 |     flagged: data.flagged || 0,
  121 |     days: args.p_days ?? 14,
  122 |     ran_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  123 |   };
  124 | }

FILE [13/107]: src/lib/apiUtils.ts (85 lines)

    1 | import { get, set } from 'idb-keyval';
    2 | 
    3 | /**
    4 |  * Safely parse JSON from a Response object, guarding against HTML fallbacks or non-JSON content
    5 |  */
    6 | export async function parseResponseJson<T = any>(res: Response, fallback: T = {} as T): Promise<T> {
    7 |   try {
    8 |     const contentType = res.headers.get('content-type');
    9 |     if (!contentType || !contentType.includes('application/json')) {
   10 |       return fallback;
   11 |     }
   12 |     return (await res.json()) as T;
   13 |   } catch {
   14 |     return fallback;
   15 |   }
   16 | }
   17 | 
   18 | /**
   19 |  * Safe API fetch utility that guarantees graceful handling of HTML fallbacks,
   20 |  * non-200 responses, network disconnects, and malformed JSON.
   21 |  * It also caches GET requests in IndexedDB for offline access.
   22 |  */
   23 | export async function safeFetchJson<T>(
   24 |   input: RequestInfo | URL,
   25 |   init?: RequestInit,
   26 |   fallbackValue: T | null = null
   27 | ): Promise<T | null> {
   28 |   const method = init?.method?.toUpperCase() || 'GET';
   29 |   const isGet = method === 'GET';
   30 |   let cacheKey = '';
   31 | 
   32 |   if (isGet) {
   33 |     const urlStr = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input instanceof URL ? input.toString() : input.url;
   34 |     cacheKey = `api_cache_${urlStr}`;
   35 |   }
   36 | 
   37 |   try {
   38 |     const res = await fetch(input, init);
   39 |     
   40 |     // Fallback to cache if response is not ok
   41 |     if (!res.ok) {
   42 |       if (isGet) {
   43 |         const cached = await get<T>(cacheKey);
   44 |         if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
   45 |       }
   46 |       return fallbackValue;
   47 |     }
   48 | 
   49 |     const contentType = res.headers.get('content-type');
   50 |     
   51 |     // Fallback to cache if response is not JSON
   52 |     if (!contentType || !contentType.includes('application/json')) {
   53 |       if (isGet) {
   54 |         const cached = await get<T>(cacheKey);
   55 |         if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
   56 |       }
   57 |       return fallbackValue;
   58 |     }
   59 | 
   60 |     const data = await res.json() as T;
   61 | 
   62 |     // Persist successful GET responses to IndexedDB
   63 |     if (isGet) {
   64 |       try {
   65 |         await set(cacheKey, data);
   66 |       } catch (e) {
   67 |         console.warn('Failed to cache API response', e);
   68 |       }
   69 |     }
   70 | 
   71 |     return data;
   72 |   } catch (error) {
   73 |     // Network error or offline: fallback to cache
   74 |     if (isGet) {
   75 |       try {
   76 |         const cached = await get<T>(cacheKey);
   77 |         if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
   78 |       } catch (e) {
   79 |         console.warn('Failed to read API cache', e);
   80 |       }
   81 |     }
   82 |     return fallbackValue;
   83 |   }
   84 | }
   85 |

    1 | import { Member, AttendanceRecord } from '../types';
    2 | 
    3 | /**
    4 |  * Generates a stable QR payload string for a member
    5 |  */
    6 | export function generateMemberQrPayload(member: Member): string {
    7 |   return `PULSE:MEMBER:${member.id}:${member.phone}`;
    8 | }
    9 | 
   10 | /**
   11 |  * Verifies and parses scanned QR payload
   12 |  */
   13 | export function verifyQrPayload(payload: string): { memberId: string; phone?: string } | null {
   14 |   if (!payload || !payload.startsWith('PULSE:MEMBER:')) {
   15 |     // Also support scanning direct member ID string or raw phone string
   16 |     if (payload.startsWith('mem_')) {
   17 |       return { memberId: payload };
   18 |     }
   19 |     return null;
   20 |   }
   21 | 
   22 |   const parts = payload.split(':');
   23 |   if (parts.length >= 3) {
   24 |     return {
   25 |       memberId: parts[2],
   26 |       phone: parts[3] || undefined
   27 |     };
   28 |   }
   29 |   return null;
   30 | }
   31 | 
   32 | /**
   33 |  * Computes check-ins for today
   34 |  */
   35 | export function getTodayAttendanceCount(attendanceList: AttendanceRecord[]): number {
   36 |   const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
   37 |   return attendanceList.filter(a => a.checked_in_at.startsWith(todayStr)).length;
   38 | }
   39 | 
   40 | /**
   41 |  * Returns attendance history for a specific member
   42 |  */
   43 | export function getAttendanceForMember(attendanceList: AttendanceRecord[], memberId: string): AttendanceRecord[] {
   44 |   return attendanceList
   45 |     .filter(a => a.member_id === memberId)
   46 |     .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.checked_in_at).getTime() - new Date(a.checked_in_at).getTime());
   47 | }
   48 | 
   49 | /**
   50 |  * Formats check-in timestamp for display
   51 |  */
   52 | export function formatAttendanceTime(isoString: string): string {
   53 |   try {
   54 |     const d = new Date(isoString);
   55 |     return d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true });
   56 |   } catch {
   57 |     return isoString;
   58 |   }
   59 | }

    1 | import { Member, Profile, CommissionSettlement, PlanPackage } from '../types';
    2 | import { PACKAGE_CONFIGS } from './membership';
    3 | 
    4 | /**
    5 |  * Gets default commission percentage rate for a package type
    6 |  */
    7 | export function getDefaultCommissionRate(packageType?: PlanPackage): number {
    8 |   if (!packageType) return 10;
    9 |   return PACKAGE_CONFIGS[packageType]?.defaultCommissionRate || 10;
   10 | }
   11 | 
   12 | /**
   13 |  * Calculates stored commission currency amount from amount paid and commission rate percentage
   14 |  */
   15 | export function calculateCommissionAmount(amountPaid: number, commissionRate: number): number {
   16 |   if (!amountPaid || amountPaid <= 0 || !commissionRate || commissionRate <= 0) return 0;
   17 |   return Math.round((amountPaid * commissionRate) / 100);
   18 | }
   19 | 
   20 | /**
   21 |  * Computes complete commission statistics for a specific trainer
   22 |  */
   23 | export function getTrainerCommissionStats(
   24 |   members: Member[],
   25 |   settlements: CommissionSettlement[],
   26 |   trainerId: string
   27 | ) {
   28 |   // Filter active/expired members onboarded or trained by this trainer
   29 |   const trainerMembers = members.filter(m => m.onboarded_by === trainerId && m.status !== 'pending');
   30 | 
   31 |   const totalGrossRevenue = trainerMembers.reduce((acc, m) => acc + (m.amount_paid || 0), 0);
   32 |   
   33 |   // Total calculated commission earned across all activated memberships
   34 |   const totalCommissionEarned = trainerMembers.reduce((acc, m) => {
   35 |     const rate = m.commission_rate ?? getDefaultCommissionRate(m.package_type);
   36 |     const amountPaid = m.amount_paid || 0;
   37 |     return acc + calculateCommissionAmount(amountPaid, rate);
   38 |   }, 0);
   39 | 
   40 |   // Total commission paid through settlements
   41 |   const trainerSettlements = settlements.filter(s => s.trainer_id === trainerId);
   42 |   const paidSettlements = trainerSettlements.filter(s => s.status === 'paid');
   43 |   
   44 |   const totalCommissionPaid = paidSettlements.reduce((acc, s) => acc + (s.total_commission || 0), 0);
   45 |   const totalCommissionPending = Math.max(0, totalCommissionEarned - totalCommissionPaid);
   46 | 
   47 |   return {
   48 |     trainerId,
   49 |     clientCount: trainerMembers.length,
   50 |     totalGrossRevenue,
   51 |     totalCommissionEarned,
   52 |     totalCommissionPaid,
   53 |     totalCommissionPending,
   54 |     settlementHistory: trainerSettlements
   55 |   };
   56 | }
   57 | 
   58 | /**
   59 |  * Computes gym-wide commission overview for Owner Dashboard
   60 |  */
   61 | export function getAllTrainersCommissionOverview(
   62 |   members: Member[],
   63 |   settlements: CommissionSettlement[],
   64 |   trainers: Profile[]
   65 | ) {
   66 |   const trainerSummaries = trainers.map(t => {
   67 |     const stats = getTrainerCommissionStats(members, settlements, t.id);
   68 |     return {
   69 |       trainer: t,
   70 |       ...stats
   71 |     };
   72 |   });
   73 | 
   74 |   const aggregatePendingCommissions = trainerSummaries.reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.totalCommissionPending, 0);
   75 |   const aggregatePaidCommissions = trainerSummaries.reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.totalCommissionPaid, 0);
   76 |   const aggregateEarnedCommissions = trainerSummaries.reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.totalCommissionEarned, 0);
   77 | 
   78 |   return {
   79 |     trainerSummaries,
   80 |     aggregateEarnedCommissions,
   81 |     aggregatePaidCommissions,
   82 |     aggregatePendingCommissions
   83 |   };
   84 | }

   54 | function normHeader(h: string) {
   55 |   return h.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_');

   58 | function parseCsv(text: string): string[][] {
   59 |   const rows: string[][] = [];
   60 |   let row: string[] = [];
   61 |   let cur = '';
   62 |   let inQuotes = false;
   63 |   for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
   64 |     const c = text[i];
   65 |     const next = text[i + 1];
   66 |     if (inQuotes) {
   67 |       if (c === '"' && next === '"') {
   68 |         cur += '"';
   69 |         i++;
   70 |       } else if (c === '"') inQuotes = false;
   71 |       else cur += c;
   72 |     } else if (c === '"') inQuotes = true;
   73 |     else if (c === ',') {
   74 |       row.push(cur.trim());
   75 |       cur = '';
   76 |     } else if (c === '\n' || c === '\r') {
   77 |       if (c === '\r' && next === '\n') i++;
   78 |       row.push(cur.trim());
   79 |       if (row.some((x) => x !== '')) rows.push(row);
   80 |       row = [];
   81 |       cur = '';
   82 |     } else cur += c;
   83 |   }
   84 |   row.push(cur.trim());
   85 |   if (row.some((x) => x !== '')) rows.push(row);
   86 |   return rows;
   87 | }
   88 | 
   89 | function parseDate(v: string): string | null {
   90 |   if (!v) return null;
   91 |   if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) return v;
   92 |   const m = v.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{4})$/);
   93 |   if (m) return `${m[3]}-${m[2].padStart(2, '0')}-${m[1].padStart(2, '0')}`;
   94 |   return null;
   95 | }
   96 | 
   97 | export function parseAndValidateMemberCsv(text: string): {
   98 |   valid: ImportRowValid[];
   99 |   errors: ImportRowError[];
  100 |   totalRows: number;
  101 | } {
  102 |   const errors: ImportRowError[] = [];
  103 |   const valid: ImportRowValid[] = [];
  104 | 
  105 |   if (!text?.trim()) {
  106 |     return { valid: [], errors: [{ rowNumber: 0, message: 'File is empty' }], totalRows: 0 };
  107 |   }
  108 | 
  109 |   const matrix = parseCsv(text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''));
  110 |   if (matrix.length < 2) {
  111 |     return {
  112 |       valid: [],
  113 |       errors: [{ rowNumber: 0, message: 'CSV needs header + at least one data row' }],
  114 |       totalRows: 0,
  115 |     };
  116 |   }
  117 | 
  118 |   const headers = matrix[0].map((h) => HEADER_MAP[normHeader(h)] || normHeader(h));
  119 |   if (!headers.includes('full_name') || !headers.includes('phone')) {
  120 |     return {
  121 |       valid: [],
  122 |       errors: [{ rowNumber: 0, message: 'Required columns: full_name (or name), phone (or mobile)' }],
  123 |       totalRows: matrix.length - 1,
  124 |     };
  125 |   }
  126 | 
  127 |   const seen = new Set<string>();
  128 | 
  129 |   for (let i = 1; i < matrix.length; i++) {
  130 |     const rowNumber = i + 1;
  131 |     const raw: Record<string, string> = {};
  132 |     headers.forEach((h, idx) => {
  133 |       raw[h] = (matrix[i][idx] ?? '').trim();
  134 |     });
  135 | 
  136 |     const full_name = (raw.full_name || '').trim();
  137 |     if (!full_name) {
  138 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'full_name', message: 'Name is required' });
  139 |       continue;
  140 |     }
  141 | 
  142 |     const phone = normalizePhone10(raw.phone || '');
  143 |     if (!phone || !isValidIndianMobile10(phone)) {
  144 |       errors.push({
  145 |         rowNumber,
  146 |         field: 'phone',
  147 |         message: 'Invalid Indian mobile (10 digits, starts with 6–9)',
  148 |       });
  149 |       continue;
  150 |     }
  151 |     if (seen.has(phone)) {
  152 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'phone', message: `Duplicate in file: ${phone}` });
  153 |       continue;
  154 |     }
  155 |     seen.add(phone);
  156 | 
  157 |     let status = (raw.status || 'active').toLowerCase();
  158 |     if (!['pending', 'active', 'expired'].includes(status)) {
  159 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'status', message: 'status must be pending, active, or expired' });
  160 |       continue;
  161 |     }
  162 | 
  163 |     let months: number | null = null;
  164 |     if (raw.months) {
  165 |       months = Number(raw.months);
  166 |       if (!Number.isInteger(months) || months < 1 || months > 12) {
  167 |         errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'months', message: 'months must be 1–12' });
  168 |         continue;
  169 |       }
  170 |     }
  171 | 
  172 |     const amount_paid = raw.amount_paid ? Number(raw.amount_paid) : 0;
  173 |     const balance_due = raw.balance_due ? Number(raw.balance_due) : 0;
  174 |     if (Number.isNaN(amount_paid) || amount_paid < 0) {
  175 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'amount_paid', message: 'Invalid amount_paid' });
  176 |       continue;
  177 |     }
  178 |     if (Number.isNaN(balance_due) || balance_due < 0) {
  179 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'balance_due', message: 'Invalid balance_due' });
  180 |       continue;
  181 |     }
  182 | 
  183 |     let age: number | null = null;
  184 |     if (raw.age) {
  185 |       age = Number(raw.age);
  186 |       if (!Number.isInteger(age) || age < 10 || age > 100) {
  187 |         errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'age', message: 'age must be between 10 and 100' });
  188 |         continue;
  189 |       }
  190 |     }
  191 | 
  192 |     const start_date = raw.start_date ? parseDate(raw.start_date) : null;
  193 |     if (raw.start_date && !start_date) {
  194 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'start_date', message: 'Use YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY' });
  195 |       continue;
  196 |     }
  197 |     const end_date = raw.end_date ? parseDate(raw.end_date) : null;
  198 |     if (raw.end_date && !end_date) {
  199 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'end_date', message: 'Use YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY' });
  200 |       continue;
  201 |     }
  202 | 
  203 |     if (raw.email && !raw.email.includes('@')) {
  204 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'email', message: 'Invalid email address' });
  205 |       continue;
  206 |     }
  207 | 
  208 |     let gender = (raw.gender || '').toLowerCase() || null;
  209 |     if (gender === 'm') gender = 'male';
  210 |     if (gender === 'f') gender = 'female';
  211 |     if (gender && !['male', 'female', 'other'].includes(gender)) {
  212 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'gender', message: 'gender must be male, female, or other' });
  213 |       continue;
  214 |     }
  215 | 
  216 |     valid.push({
  217 |       rowNumber,
  218 |       full_name,
  219 |       phone,
  220 |       gender,
  221 |       age,
  222 |       email: raw.email || null,
  223 |       start_date,
  224 |       end_date,
  225 |       months,
  226 |       package_type: raw.package_type || null,
  227 |       amount_paid,
  228 |       balance_due,
  229 |       status: status as ImportRowValid['status'],
  230 |       notes: raw.notes || null,
  231 |     });
  232 |   }
  233 | 
  234 |   return { valid, errors, totalRows: matrix.length - 1 };
  235 | }

    1 | import { Member, ContactExportResult } from '../types';

    4 | /**
    5 |  * Generates a compliant vCard 3.0 block for a single member
    6 |  */
    7 | export function generateVCard30(member: Member, gymPrefix: string = 'Pulse Gym'): string {
    8 |   const cleanPhone = normalizeIndianPhone(member.phone);
    9 |   const formattedPhone = cleanPhone ? `+91${cleanPhone}` : member.phone;
   10 |   
   11 |   const formattedName = member.full_name.trim();
   12 |   const orgName = member.branch_name ? `${gymPrefix} - ${member.branch_name}` : gymPrefix;
   13 |   const statusNote = `Status: ${member.status.toUpperCase()} | Package: ${member.package_type || 'N/A'}`;
   14 |   const trainerNote = member.trainer_name ? `Trainer: ${member.trainer_name}` : '';
   15 |   const noteContent = [statusNote, trainerNote, member.notes].filter(Boolean).join(' | ');
   16 | 
   17 |   const vcardLines = [
   18 |     'BEGIN:VCARD',
   19 |     'VERSION:3.0',
   20 |     `N:;${formattedName};;;`,
   21 |     `FN:${formattedName}`,
   22 |     `ORG:${orgName}`,
   23 |     `TEL;TYPE=CELL,VOICE:${formattedPhone}`,
   24 |   ];
   25 | 
   26 |   if (member.email) {
   27 |     vcardLines.push(`EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET:${member.email.trim()}`);
   28 |   }
   29 | 
   30 |   if (noteContent) {
   31 |     vcardLines.push(`NOTE:${noteContent}`);
   32 |   }
   33 | 
   34 |   vcardLines.push('END:VCARD');
   35 |   return vcardLines.join('\r\n');
   36 | }
   37 | 
   38 | /**
   39 |  * Bulk exports members into a single merged .vcf file string with duplicate detection
   40 |  */
   41 | export function buildBulkVCardExport(
   42 |   members: Member[],
   43 |   filterName: string = 'All Members',
   44 |   gymPrefix: string = 'Pulse Gym'
   45 | ): ContactExportResult {
   46 |   const seenPhones = new Set<string>();
   47 |   const validVCards: string[] = [];
   48 |   const skippedMembers: Array<{ name: string; phone: string; reason: string }> = [];
   49 | 
   50 |   let addedCount = 0;
   51 |   let skippedDuplicatesCount = 0;
   52 | 
   53 |   for (const member of members) {
   54 |     const clean = normalizeIndianPhone(member.phone);
   55 |     if (!clean) {
   56 |       skippedMembers.push({
   57 |         name: member.full_name,
   58 |         phone: member.phone,
   59 |         reason: 'Invalid 10-digit phone number format'
   60 |       });
   61 |       continue;
   62 |     }
   63 | 
   64 |     if (seenPhones.has(clean)) {
   65 |       skippedDuplicatesCount++;
   66 |       skippedMembers.push({
   67 |         name: member.full_name,
   68 |         phone: member.phone,
   69 |         reason: 'Duplicate phone number already exported'
   70 |       });
   71 |       continue;
   72 |     }
   73 | 
   74 |     seenPhones.add(clean);
   75 |     validVCards.push(generateVCard30(member, gymPrefix));
   76 |     addedCount++;
   77 |   }
   78 | 
   79 |   const vcardContent = validVCards.join('\r\n\r\n');
   80 |   const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
   81 |   const sanitizedFilter = filterName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_');
   82 |   const filename = `pulse_fitness_contacts_${sanitizedFilter}_${dateStr}.vcf`;
   83 | 
   84 |   return {
   85 |     totalProcessed: members.length,
   86 |     addedCount,
   87 |     skippedDuplicatesCount,
   88 |     skippedMembers,
   89 |     vcardContent,
   90 |     filename
   91 |   };
   92 | }
   93 | 
   94 | /**
   95 |  * Triggers a browser download of a generated file (VCF or CSV)
   96 |  */
   97 | export function downloadFileInBrowser(content: string, filename: string, mimeType: string = 'text/vcard') {
   98 |   const blob = new Blob([content], { type: `${mimeType};charset=utf-8` });
   99 |   const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  100 |   const link = document.createElement('a');
  101 |   link.href = url;
  102 |   link.setAttribute('download', filename);
  103 |   document.body.appendChild(link);
  104 |   link.click();
  105 |   document.body.removeChild(link);
  106 |   URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  107 | }

   29 | export function mapAttendanceError(message: string): string {
   30 |   if (!message) return 'Check-in failed';
   31 |   const lower = message.toLowerCase();
   32 |   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ATTENDANCE_ERRORS)) {
   33 |     if (lower.includes(k.toLowerCase()) || lower.includes(v.toLowerCase())) return v;
   34 |   }
   35 |   if (/load failed|failed to fetch|network/i.test(message)) {
   36 |     return 'Network error — try again';
   37 |   }
   38 |   return message;

FILE [22/107]: src/lib/duesAging.ts (42 lines)

    1 | // src/lib/duesAging.ts
    2 | export type AgingBucket = 'current' | 'late' | 'bad_debt';
    3 | 
    4 | export function agingBucket(daysOverdue: number): AgingBucket {
    5 |   if (daysOverdue <= 7) return 'current';
    6 |   if (daysOverdue <= 30) return 'late';
    7 |   return 'bad_debt';
    8 | }
    9 | 
   10 | export function groupByAging<T extends { days_overdue: number; balance_due: number }>(
   11 |   rows: T[]
   12 | ): {
   13 |   current: T[];
   14 |   late: T[];
   15 |   badDebt: T[];
   16 |   totals: {
   17 |     current: number;
   18 |     late: number;
   19 |     badDebt: number;
   20 |     all: number;
   21 |   };
   22 | } {
   23 |   const current: T[] = rows.filter((r) => agingBucket(r.days_overdue) === 'current');
   24 |   const late: T[] = rows.filter((r) => agingBucket(r.days_overdue) === 'late');
   25 |   const badDebt: T[] = rows.filter((r) => agingBucket(r.days_overdue) === 'bad_debt');
   26 |   
   27 |   const sum = (xs: T[]) =>
   28 |     xs.reduce((s, r) => s + Number(r.balance_due || 0), 0);
   29 | 
   30 |   return {
   31 |     current,
   32 |     late,
   33 |     badDebt,
   34 |     totals: {
   35 |       current: sum(current),
   36 |       late: sum(late),
   37 |       badDebt: sum(badDebt),
   38 |       all: sum(rows),
   39 |     },
   40 |   };
   41 | }

   30 | export type AppErrorShape = {
   31 |   code: string;
   32 |   message: string;
   33 |   status?: number;
   34 |   details?: unknown;
   35 |   reauth?: boolean;
   36 |   retryable?: boolean;

   38 | 
   39 | export function toAppError(err: unknown, fallbackCode = 'UNKNOWN'): AppErrorShape {
   40 |   const e = err as any;
   41 |   const raw = String(e?.message || e || '');
   42 |   const status = Number(e?.status || e?.statusCode || 0) || undefined;
   43 |   const codeFromPg =
   44 |     e?.code ||
   45 |     raw.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{3,})\b/)?.[1] ||
   46 |     '';
   47 | 
   48 |   // PostgREST / RPC Auth Session
   49 |   if (status === 401 || /jwt|session|auth.?session/i.test(raw) || e?.name === 'AuthSessionMissingError') {
   50 |     return {
   51 |       code: 'AUTH_SESSION_MISSING',
   52 |       message: ERROR_CODES.AUTH_SESSION_MISSING,
   53 |       status: 401,
   54 |       reauth: true,
   55 |       retryable: false,
   56 |     };
   57 |   }
   58 | 
   59 |   if (status === 403 || codeFromPg === '42501' || /FORBIDDEN/i.test(raw)) {
   60 |     return {
   61 |       code: 'FORBIDDEN',
   62 |       message: ERROR_CODES.FORBIDDEN,
   63 |       status: 403,
   64 |       retryable: false,
   65 |     };
   66 |   }
   67 | 
   68 |   if (codeFromPg === '23505' || /duplicate|unique/i.test(raw)) {
   69 |     return {
   70 |       code: 'CONFLICT',
   71 |       message: ERROR_CODES.CONFLICT,
   72 |       status: 409,
   73 |       retryable: false,
   74 |     };
   75 |   }
   76 | 
   77 |   if (status === 429 || /RATE_LIMITED|too many/i.test(raw)) {
   78 |     return {
   79 |       code: 'RATE_LIMITED',
   80 |       message: ERROR_CODES.RATE_LIMITED,
   81 |       status: 429,
   82 |       retryable: true,
   83 |     };
   84 |   }
   85 | 
   86 |   if (/load failed|failed to fetch|networkerror|TypeError/i.test(raw)) {
   87 |     return {
   88 |       code: 'NETWORK',
   89 |       message: ERROR_CODES.NETWORK,
   90 |       retryable: true,
   91 |     };
   92 |   }
   93 | 
   94 |   // Explicit app codes raised from SQL RAISE EXCEPTION 'CODE'
   95 |   for (const code of Object.keys(ERROR_CODES)) {
   96 |     if (raw.includes(code) || codeFromPg === code) {
   97 |       return {
   98 |         code,
   99 |         message: ERROR_CODES[code] || raw,
  100 |         status,
  101 |         retryable: ['NETWORK', 'MSG91_HTTP_ERROR', 'VAULT_READ_FAILED', 'RATE_LIMITED'].includes(code),
  102 |         details: e?.details,
  103 |       };
  104 |     }
  105 |   }
  106 | 
  107 |   // Attendance-style embeds
  108 |   if (/already_checked_in/i.test(raw)) {
  109 |     return { code: 'ALREADY_CHECKED_IN', message: ERROR_CODES.ALREADY_CHECKED_IN, retryable: false };
  110 |   }
  111 | 
  112 |   return {
  113 |     code: fallbackCode,
  114 |     message: raw || ERROR_CODES.UNKNOWN,
  115 |     status,
  116 |     retryable: false,
  117 |     details: e,
  118 |   };
  119 | }

    4 | /**
    5 |  * Hardened vCard (v3.0) content generator for Pulse Fitness Gym
    6 |  */
    7 | export function generateHardenedVCard(
    8 |   members: Member[],
    9 |   existingPhonesSet: Set<string> = new Set()
   10 | ): ContactExportResult {
   11 |   let vcardOutput = '';
   12 |   let addedCount = 0;
   13 |   let skippedDuplicatesCount = 0;
   14 |   const skippedMembers: Array<{ name: string; phone: string; reason: string }> = [];
   15 | 
   16 |   const seenInBatch = new Set<string>();
   17 | 
   18 |   members.forEach((member) => {
   19 |     // Soft archived members skipped from contact sync unless explicitly targeted
   20 |     if (member.is_archived) return;
   21 | 
   22 |     const cleanPhone = normalizeIndianPhone(member.phone);
   23 |     
   24 |     // Duplicate check against existing device contacts or duplicate batch items
   25 |     if (existingPhonesSet.has(cleanPhone) || seenInBatch.has(cleanPhone)) {
   26 |       skippedDuplicatesCount++;
   27 |       skippedMembers.push({
   28 |         name: member.full_name,
   29 |         phone: formatPhoneDisplay(member.phone),
   30 |         reason: 'Phone number already exists in contacts list'
   31 |       });
   32 |       return;
   33 |     }
   34 | 
   35 |     seenInBatch.add(cleanPhone);
   36 |     addedCount++;
   37 | 
   38 |     const formattedPhone = cleanPhone.length === 10 ? `+91${cleanPhone}` : member.phone;
   39 |     const nameParts = member.full_name.trim().split(' ');
   40 |     const firstName = nameParts[0] || '';
   41 |     const lastName = nameParts.slice(1).join(' ') || '';
   42 | 
   43 |     const joinDate = member.start_date || member.created_at.split('T')[0];
   44 |     const duration = member.subscription_months ? `${member.subscription_months} Months` : 'Pending';
   45 |     const pkg = member.package_type || 'General Gym';
   46 |     const trainerInfo = member.trainer_name ? `Trainer: ${member.trainer_name}` : 'No Trainer Assigned';
   47 |     const balanceInfo = member.balance_due && member.balance_due > 0 ? ` [Balance Due: ₹${member.balance_due}]` : '';
   48 | 
   49 |     const richNote = `Pulse Fitness Gym Member • Joined: ${joinDate} • Plan: ${pkg} (${duration}) • ${trainerInfo}${balanceInfo}${member.notes ? ` • Note: ${member.notes}` : ''}`;
   50 | 
   51 |     vcardOutput += `BEGIN:VCARD\r\n`;
   52 |     vcardOutput += `VERSION:3.0\r\n`;
   53 |     vcardOutput += `N:${lastName};${firstName};;;\r\n`;
   54 |     vcardOutput += `FN:${member.full_name}\r\n`;
   55 |     vcardOutput += `ORG:Pulse Fitness Gym\r\n`;
   56 |     vcardOutput += `TITLE:Gym Member (${pkg})\r\n`;
   57 |     vcardOutput += `TEL;TYPE=CELL,VOICE:${formattedPhone}\r\n`;
   58 |     if (member.email) {
   59 |       vcardOutput += `EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET:${member.email}\r\n`;
   60 |     }
   61 |     vcardOutput += `NOTE:${richNote}\r\n`;
   62 |     vcardOutput += `CATEGORIES:Pulse Fitness Gym, Members\r\n`;
   63 |     vcardOutput += `END:VCARD\r\n`;
   64 |   });
   65 | 
   66 |   const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
   67 |   const filename = `Pulse_Fitness_Gym_Contacts_${timestamp}.vcf`;
   68 | 
   69 |   return {
   70 |     totalProcessed: members.length,
   71 |     addedCount,
   72 |     skippedDuplicatesCount,
   73 |     skippedMembers,
   74 |     vcardContent: vcardOutput,
   75 |     filename
   76 |   };
   77 | }

  156 | export async function logExportAudit(
  157 |   userProfile: Profile,
  158 |   exportType: 'vcf' | 'csv' | 'clipboard',
  159 |   filterUsed: string,
  160 |   memberCount: number
  161 | ): Promise<ExportLogRecord | null> {

   14 | function esc(v: unknown): string {
   15 |   const s = String(v ?? '');
   16 |   if (/[",\n\r]/.test(s)) return `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
   17 |   return s;
   18 | }
   19 | 
   20 | export function membersToCsv(rows: MemberCsvRow[]): string {
   21 |   const header = [
   22 |     'full_name',
   23 |     'phone',
   24 |     'email',
   25 |     'gender',
   26 |     'status',
   27 |     'end_date',
   28 |     'balance_due',
   29 |     'package_type',
   30 |     'branch',
   31 |   ];
   32 |   const lines = [header.join(',')];
   33 |   for (const r of rows) {
   34 |     const phone = String(r.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10);
   35 |     lines.push(
   36 |       [
   37 |         esc(r.full_name),
   38 |         esc(phone ? `91${phone}` : ''),
   39 |         esc(r.email || ''),
   40 |         esc(r.gender || ''),
   41 |         esc(r.status || ''),
   42 |         esc(r.end_date || ''),
   43 |         esc(r.balance_due ?? ''),
   44 |         esc(r.package_type || ''),
   45 |         esc(r.branch_name || ''),
   46 |       ].join(',')
   47 |     );
   48 |   }
   49 |   return lines.join('\n');
   50 | }

  175 | /**
  176 |  * Call Google Gemini provider
  177 |  */
  178 | async function callGemini(
  179 |   messages: FreeLLMChatMessage[],
  180 |   modelName: string
  181 | ): Promise<{ content: string; promptTokens: number; completionTokens: number }> {
  182 |   const ai = getGeminiClient();
  183 | 
  184 |   // Separate system instruction from conversation contents
  185 |   const systemMsg = messages.find((m) => m.role === 'system');
  186 |   const userAndAssistantMsgs = messages.filter((m) => m.role !== 'system');
  187 | 
  188 |   const formattedPrompt = userAndAssistantMsgs
  189 |     .map((m) => `${m.role.toUpperCase()}: ${m.content}`)
  190 |     .join('\n\n');
  191 | 
  192 |   const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
  193 |     model: modelName || 'gemini-3.8-flash',
  194 |     contents: formattedPrompt,
  195 |     config: systemMsg
  196 |       ? {
  197 |           systemInstruction: systemMsg.content,
  198 |           temperature: 0.7,
  199 |         }
  200 |       : {
  201 |           temperature: 0.7,
  202 |         },
  203 |   });
  204 | 
  205 |   const content = response.text || '';
  206 |   // Estimate tokens based on length (~4 chars per token)
  207 |   const promptTokens = Math.ceil(formattedPrompt.length / 4);
  208 |   const completionTokens = Math.ceil(content.length / 4);
  209 | 
  210 |   return { content, promptTokens, completionTokens };
  211 | }

  213 | /**
  214 |  * Call OpenAI-compatible HTTP upstream provider (Groq, Cerebras, Mistral, OpenRouter, GitHub)
  215 |  */
  216 | async function callOpenAICompatible(
  217 |   providerId: LLMProviderId,
  218 |   messages: FreeLLMChatMessage[],
  219 |   modelName: string
  220 | ): Promise<{ content: string; promptTokens: number; completionTokens: number }> {
  221 |   const config = providerConfigs[providerId];
  222 |   if (!config || !config.baseUrl) {
  223 |     throw new Error(`Provider ${providerId} missing baseUrl configuration`);
  224 |   }
  225 | 
  226 |   const apiKey = config.apiKey;
  227 |   if (!apiKey) {
  228 |     throw new Error(`Provider ${providerId} has no API key configured`);
  229 |   }
  230 | 
  231 |   const endpoint = `${config.baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/chat/completions`;
  232 | 
  233 |   const headers: Record<string, string> = {
  234 |     'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  235 |     Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
  236 |     'User-Agent': 'FreeLLMAPI-Router/1.0 (PulseFitness)',
  237 |   };
  238 | 
  239 |   if (providerId === 'openrouter') {
  240 |     headers['HTTP-Referer'] = 'https://pulsefitness.in';
  241 |     headers['X-Title'] = 'Pulse Fitness Gym OS';
  242 |   }
  243 | 
  244 |   const controller = new AbortController();
  245 |   const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 12000); // 12s timeout
  246 | 
  247 |   try {
  248 |     const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
  249 |       method: 'POST',
  250 |       headers,
  251 |       body: JSON.stringify({
  252 |         model: modelName || config.model,
  253 |         messages: messages.map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content })),
  254 |         temperature: 0.7,
  255 |         max_tokens: 1500,
  256 |       }),
  257 |       signal: controller.signal,
  258 |     });
  259 | 
  260 |     clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  261 | 
  262 |     if (!res.ok) {
  263 |       const errText = await res.text().catch(() => '');
  264 |       throw new Error(`Upstream ${providerId} HTTP ${res.status}: ${errText.slice(0, 200)}`);
  265 |     }
  266 | 
  267 |     const data = await res.json();
  268 |     const content = data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';
  269 |     const promptTokens = data?.usage?.prompt_tokens || Math.ceil(JSON.stringify(messages).length / 4);
  270 |     const completionTokens = data?.usage?.completion_tokens || Math.ceil(content.length / 4);
  271 | 
  272 |     return { content, promptTokens, completionTokens };
  273 |   } catch (err: any) {
  274 |     clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  275 |     throw err;
  276 |   }
  277 | }

  355 | /**
  356 |  * Core FreeLLMAPI Smart Router:
  357 |  * Cascades across free-tier providers with automatic failover!
  358 |  */
  359 | export async function executeFreeLLMCompletion(
  360 |   messages: FreeLLMChatMessage[],
  361 |   preferredModel?: string,
  362 |   preferredProvider?: LLMProviderId
  363 | ): Promise<FreeLLMCompletionResponse> {
  364 |   const startTime = Date.now();
  365 |   const failoverHistory: FreeLLMFailoverHop[] = [];
  366 | 
  367 |   // Determine priority cascade order
  368 |   const providersInOrder: LLMProviderId[] = [
  369 |     preferredProvider || 'gemini',
  370 |     'groq',
  371 |     'cerebras',
  372 |     'mistral',
  373 |     'openrouter',
  374 |     'github',
  375 |   ].filter((p, i, arr) => arr.indexOf(p) === i) as LLMProviderId[];
  376 | 
  377 |   let resultText = '';
  378 |   let providerUsed: LLMProviderId = 'gemini';
  379 |   let modelUsed = preferredModel || 'gemini-3.8-flash';
  380 |   let promptTokens = 0;
  381 |   let completionTokens = 0;
  382 | 
  383 |   for (const providerId of providersInOrder) {
  384 |     const config = providerConfigs[providerId];
  385 |     if (!config || !config.enabled) continue;
  386 | 
  387 |     // Check if key is available (Gemini falls back to process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY)
  388 |     if (providerId === 'gemini') {
  389 |       const gemKey = config.apiKey || process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
  390 |       if (!gemKey) {
  391 |         failoverHistory.push({
  392 |           attemptedProvider: 'gemini',
  393 |           model: config.model,
  394 |           reason: 'GEMINI_API_KEY not set in environment or config',
  395 |           timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  396 |         });
  397 |         continue;
  398 |       }
  399 |     } else {
  400 |       if (!config.apiKey) {
  401 |         failoverHistory.push({
  402 |           attemptedProvider: providerId,
  403 |           model: config.model,
  404 |           reason: `No API key supplied for ${providerId}`,
  405 |           timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  406 |         });
  407 |         continue;
  408 |       }
  409 |     }
  410 | 
  411 |     try {
  412 |       if (providerId === 'gemini') {
  413 |         const gemResult = await callGemini(messages, preferredModel || config.model);
  414 |         resultText = gemResult.content;
  415 |         promptTokens = gemResult.promptTokens;
  416 |         completionTokens = gemResult.completionTokens;
  417 |         providerUsed = 'gemini';
  418 |         modelUsed = preferredModel || config.model;
  419 |         providerHealthCache.gemini.status = 'healthy';
  420 |         providerHealthCache.gemini.lastTested = new Date().toISOString();
  421 |         break;
  422 |       } else {
  423 |         const openResult = await callOpenAICompatible(
  424 |           providerId,
  425 |           messages,
  426 |           preferredModel || config.model
  427 |         );
  428 |         resultText = openResult.content;
  429 |         promptTokens = openResult.promptTokens;
  430 |         completionTokens = openResult.completionTokens;
  431 |         providerUsed = providerId;
  432 |         modelUsed = preferredModel || config.model;
  433 |         providerHealthCache[providerId].status = 'healthy';
  434 |         providerHealthCache[providerId].lastTested = new Date().toISOString();
  435 |         break;
  436 |       }
  437 |     } catch (err: any) {
  438 |       console.warn(`[FreeLLMAPI] Failover from ${providerId}:`, err?.message || err);
  439 |       failoverHistory.push({
  440 |         attemptedProvider: providerId,
  441 |         model: config.model,
  442 |         reason: err?.message?.slice(0, 150) || 'Network/Rate limit failure',
  443 |         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  444 |       });
  445 |       providerHealthCache[providerId].status = 'rate_limited';
  446 |     }
  447 |   }
  448 | 
  449 |   // If all providers failed or unconfigured, execute smart local fallback
  450 |   if (!resultText) {
  451 |     resultText = generateLocalFitnessFallback(messages);
  452 |     providerUsed = 'gemini';
  453 |     modelUsed = 'pulse-local-smart-engine';
  454 |     promptTokens = Math.ceil(JSON.stringify(messages).length / 4);
  455 |     completionTokens = Math.ceil(resultText.length / 4);
  456 |     failoverHistory.push({
  457 |       attemptedProvider: 'gemini',
  458 |       model: 'pulse-local-smart-engine',
  459 |       reason: 'All remote API endpoints exhausted; used built-in offline fitness engine',
  460 |       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  461 |     });
  462 |   }
  463 | 
  464 |   const latencyMs = Date.now() - startTime;
  465 |   const totalTokens = promptTokens + completionTokens;
  466 | 
  467 |   // Approximate OpenAI GPT-4o equivalent cost saved ($30/1M tokens avg)
  468 |   const costSaved = Number(((totalTokens / 1000000) * 30).toFixed(4));
  469 | 
  470 |   // Update stats
  471 |   stats.totalRequests += 1;
  472 |   stats.totalTokens += totalTokens;
  473 |   stats.averageLatencyMs = Math.round((stats.averageLatencyMs * (stats.totalRequests - 1) + latencyMs) / stats.totalRequests);
  474 |   stats.totalCostSavedUsd = Number((stats.totalCostSavedUsd + costSaved).toFixed(2));
  475 |   if (failoverHistory.length > 0) {
  476 |     stats.failoversCount += failoverHistory.length;
  477 |   }
  478 |   stats.activeProvider = providerUsed;
  479 |   stats.lastRequestAt = new Date().toISOString();
  480 | 
  481 |   return {
  482 |     id: `chatcmpl_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
  483 |     provider: providerUsed,
  484 |     model: modelUsed,
  485 |     content: resultText,
  486 |     usage: {
  487 |       prompt_tokens: promptTokens,
  488 |       completion_tokens: completionTokens,
  489 |       total_tokens: totalTokens,
  490 |     },
  491 |     failoverHistory: failoverHistory.length > 0 ? failoverHistory : undefined,
  492 |     latencyMs,
  493 |     costEstimatedSavedUsd: costSaved,
  494 |   };
  495 | }
  496 |

  554 | export async function testProviderLatency(
  555 |   providerId: LLMProviderId
  556 | ): Promise<{ success: boolean; latencyMs: number; error?: string }> {
  557 |   const startTime = Date.now();
  558 |   const testMessages: FreeLLMChatMessage[] = [
  559 |     { role: 'system', content: 'Respond with 1 word: Pong' },
  560 |     { role: 'user', content: 'Ping' },
  561 |   ];
  562 | 
  563 |   try {
  564 |     const config = providerConfigs[providerId];
  565 |     if (providerId === 'gemini') {
  566 |       const key = config.apiKey || process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
  567 |       if (!key) throw new Error('GEMINI_API_KEY not configured');
  568 |       await callGemini(testMessages, config.model);
  569 |     } else {
  570 |       if (!config.apiKey) throw new Error(`API key for ${providerId} not set`);
  571 |       await callOpenAICompatible(providerId, testMessages, config.model);
  572 |     }
  573 | 
  574 |     const latency = Date.now() - startTime;
  575 |     providerHealthCache[providerId] = {
  576 |       latencyMs: latency,
  577 |       status: 'healthy',
  578 |       lastTested: new Date().toISOString(),
  579 |     };
  580 |     return { success: true, latencyMs: latency };
  581 |   } catch (err: any) {
  582 |     const latency = Date.now() - startTime;
  583 |     providerHealthCache[providerId] = {
  584 |       latencyMs: latency,
  585 |       status: 'degraded',
  586 |       lastTested: new Date().toISOString(),
  587 |     };
  588 |     return { success: false, latencyMs: latency, error: err?.message || 'Connection failed' };
  589 |   }
  590 | }

    1 | // src/lib/handleMutationError.ts
    2 | import { toast } from './toast';
    3 | import { RpcError } from './rpc';
    4 | import { toAppError, type AppErrorShape } from './errors';
    5 | 
    6 | export function handleMutationError(
    7 |   err: unknown,
    8 |   opts?: { onReauth?: () => void; fallbackTitle?: string }
    9 | ): AppErrorShape {
   10 |   const shape = err instanceof RpcError ? err.shape : toAppError(err);
   11 | 
   12 |   if (shape.reauth) {
   13 |     toast.error(shape.message, {
   14 |       description: 'Your authentication token has expired. Please re-authenticate.',
   15 |     });
   16 |     opts?.onReauth?.();
   17 |     return shape;
   18 |   }
   19 | 
   20 |   toast.error(shape.message, {
   21 |     description: shape.retryable ? 'Temporary glitch — please try again.' : undefined,
   22 |   });
   23 | 
   24 |   return shape;
   25 | }

    1 | // src/lib/logPromiseToPay.ts
    2 | import { safeFetchJson } from './apiUtils';
    3 | import { callRpc } from './rpc';
    4 | 
    5 | export type PromisePreset = 'tomorrow' | '3d' | 'next_week' | 'custom';
    6 | 
    7 | export function promiseDateFromPreset(preset: PromisePreset, custom?: string) {
    8 |   const today = new Date();
    9 |   if (preset === 'tomorrow') {
   10 |     today.setDate(today.getDate() + 1);
   11 |     return today.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
   12 |   }
   13 |   if (preset === '3d') {
   14 |     today.setDate(today.getDate() + 3);
   15 |     return today.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
   16 |   }
   17 |   if (preset === 'next_week') {
   18 |     today.setDate(today.getDate() + 7);
   19 |     return today.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
   20 |   }
   21 |   if (custom) return custom;
   22 |   today.setDate(today.getDate() + 1);
   23 |   return today.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
   24 | }
   25 | 
   26 | export async function logPromiseToPay(input: {
   27 |   memberId: string;
   28 |   branchId?: string | null;
   29 |   balanceDue: number;
   30 |   preset: PromisePreset;
   31 |   customDate?: string;
   32 |   actorId?: string;
   33 |   notes?: string;
   34 | }) {
   35 |   const promised_date = promiseDateFromPreset(input.preset, input.customDate);
   36 |   
   37 |   try {
   38 |     // Log via direct endpoint or RPC
   39 |     await safeFetchJson('/api/balance-reminders/log', {
   40 |       method: 'POST',
   41 |       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   42 |       body: JSON.stringify({
   43 |         member_id: input.memberId,
   44 |         branch_id: input.branchId || null,
   45 |         balance_due: input.balanceDue,
   46 |         channel: 'call',
   47 |         status: 'sent',
   48 |         outcome: 'promised',
   49 |         promised_date,
   50 |         error_message: input.notes ? `PTP note: ${input.notes}` : undefined,
   51 |         actor_id: input.actorId || null,
   52 |       }),
   53 |     });
   54 |   } catch (err) {
   55 |     console.warn('Could not log promise to pay:', err);
   56 |   }

   59 | }

   36 | /**
   37 |  * Calculates remaining days until membership expiration
   38 |  */
   39 | export function calculateDaysRemaining(endDateStr?: string): number {
   40 |   if (!endDateStr) return 0;
   41 |   const today = new Date();
   42 |   today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
   43 | 
   44 |   const end = new Date(endDateStr);
   45 |   end.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
   46 | 
   47 |   const diffTime = end.getTime() - today.getTime();
   48 |   return Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
   49 | }
   50 | 
   51 | /**
   52 |  * Returns detailed membership lifecycle info
   53 |  */
   54 | export function getExpiryStatus(endDateStr?: string) {
   55 |   const daysRemaining = calculateDaysRemaining(endDateStr);
   56 |   const isExpired = daysRemaining < 0;
   57 |   const isExpiringIn7 = daysRemaining >= 0 && daysRemaining <= 7;
   58 |   const isExpiringIn15 = daysRemaining >= 0 && daysRemaining <= 15;
   59 |   const isExpiringIn30 = daysRemaining >= 0 && daysRemaining <= 30;
   60 | 
   61 |   return {
   62 |     isExpired,
   63 |     daysRemaining,
   64 |     isExpiringIn7,
   65 |     isExpiringIn15,
   66 |     isExpiringIn30
   67 |   };
   68 | }

   70 | /**
   71 |  * Automatically calculates status based on end_date & archived state
   72 |  */
   73 | export function resolveMemberStatus(member: Member): MemberStatus {
   74 |   if (member.is_archived) return member.status;
   75 |   if (member.status === 'pending') return 'pending';
   76 |   
   77 |   if (member.end_date) {
   78 |     const days = calculateDaysRemaining(member.end_date);
   79 |     if (days < 0) return 'expired';
   80 |   }
   81 |   return member.status;
   82 | }
   83 | 
   84 | export type ExpiryFilterType = 'all' | 'expiring_7' | 'expiring_15' | 'expiring_30' | 'expired' | 'pending' | 'active' | 'archived';
   85 | 
   86 | /**
   87 |  * Filters list of members based on intelligence category
   88 |  */
   89 | export function filterMembersByIntelligence(
   90 |   members: Member[],
   91 |   filter: ExpiryFilterType,
   92 |   trainerId?: string
   93 | ): Member[] {
   94 |   let list = [...members];
   95 | 
   96 |   // Filter trainer if provided
   97 |   if (trainerId) {
   98 |     list = list.filter(m => m.onboarded_by === trainerId);
   99 |   }
  100 | 
  101 |   // Handle archive visibility
  102 |   if (filter === 'archived') {
  103 |     return list.filter(m => m.is_archived === true);
  104 |   } else {
  105 |     // Normal views hide archived members
  106 |     list = list.filter(m => !m.is_archived);
  107 |   }
  108 | 
  109 |   switch (filter) {
  110 |     case 'expiring_7':
  111 |       return list.filter(m => m.status === 'active' && m.end_date && calculateDaysRemaining(m.end_date) >= 0 && calculateDaysRemaining(m.end_date) <= 7);
  112 |     case 'expiring_15':
  113 |       return list.filter(m => m.status === 'active' && m.end_date && calculateDaysRemaining(m.end_date) >= 0 && calculateDaysRemaining(m.end_date) <= 15);
  114 |     case 'expiring_30':
  115 |       return list.filter(m => m.status === 'active' && m.end_date && calculateDaysRemaining(m.end_date) >= 0 && calculateDaysRemaining(m.end_date) <= 30);
  116 |     case 'expired':
  117 |       return list.filter(m => m.status === 'expired' || (m.end_date && calculateDaysRemaining(m.end_date) < 0));
  118 |     case 'pending':
  119 |       return list.filter(m => m.status === 'pending');
  120 |     case 'active':
  121 |       return list.filter(m => m.status === 'active' && (!m.end_date || calculateDaysRemaining(m.end_date) >= 0));
  122 |     case 'all':
  123 |     default:
  124 |       return list;
  125 |   }
  126 | }
  127 | 
  128 | /**
  129 |  * Calculate recommended total renewal cost and end date
  130 |  */
  131 | export function calculateRenewalPreFill(member: Member, renewalMonths: number = 1, packageType?: PlanPackage) {
  132 |   const pkgName = packageType || member.package_type || 'General Gym';
  133 |   const pkgConfig = PACKAGE_CONFIGS[pkgName] || PACKAGE_CONFIGS['General Gym'];
  134 | 
  135 |   const basePrice = pkgConfig.pricePerMonth * renewalMonths;
  136 |   const defaultCommissionRate = pkgConfig.defaultCommissionRate;
  137 |   
  138 |   // Calculate new start date: if currently active and not expired, start from current end_date, else today
  139 |   const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  140 |   let newStartDate = todayStr;
  141 |   
  142 |   if (member.end_date && calculateDaysRemaining(member.end_date) >= 0) {
  143 |     newStartDate = member.end_date;
  144 |   }
  145 | 
  146 |   const startDateObj = new Date(newStartDate);
  147 |   startDateObj.setMonth(startDateObj.getMonth() + renewalMonths);
  148 |   const newEndDate = startDateObj.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  149 | 
  150 |   return {
  151 |     packageType: pkgName,
  152 |     renewalMonths,
  153 |     suggestedAmount: basePrice,
  154 |     defaultCommissionRate,
  155 |     newStartDate,
  156 |     newEndDate
  157 |   };
  158 | }

FILE [31/107]: src/lib/offline-queue.ts (99 lines)
