    1 | // Offline Resilience Mutation Queue for Pulse Fitness
    2 | 
    3 | const QUEUE_STORAGE_KEY = 'pulse_fitness_mutation_queue_v1';
    4 | 
    5 | export interface QueuedMutationItem {
    6 |   id: string;
    7 |   type: string;
    8 |   variables: any;
    9 |   endpoint?: string;
   10 |   method?: string;
   11 |   timestamp: number;
   12 | }
   13 | 
   14 | export function getLocalMutationQueue(): QueuedMutationItem[] {
   15 |   try {
   16 |     const raw = localStorage.getItem(QUEUE_STORAGE_KEY);
   17 |     return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
   18 |   } catch (e) {
   19 |     console.error('Failed to read mutation queue:', e);
   20 |     return [];
   21 |   }
   22 | }
   23 | 
   24 | export function saveLocalMutationQueue(queue: QueuedMutationItem[]): void {
   25 |   try {
   26 |     localStorage.setItem(QUEUE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(queue));
   27 |   } catch (e) {
   28 |     console.error('Failed to save mutation queue:', e);
   29 |   }
   30 | }
   31 | 
   32 | export async function enqueueMutation(payload: {
   33 |   type: string;
   34 |   variables: any;
   35 |   endpoint?: string;
   36 |   method?: string;
   37 |   timestamp?: number;
   38 | }): Promise<string> {
   39 |   const queue = getLocalMutationQueue();
   40 |   const newItem: QueuedMutationItem = {
   41 |     id: `queue_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 6)}`,
   42 |     type: payload.type,
   43 |     variables: payload.variables,
   44 |     endpoint: payload.endpoint,
   45 |     method: payload.method || 'POST',
   46 |     timestamp: payload.timestamp || Date.now(),
   47 |   };
   48 | 
   49 |   queue.push(newItem);
   50 |   saveLocalMutationQueue(queue);
   51 |   console.log(`[OfflineQueue] Enqueued mutation ${newItem.type} (${newItem.id})`);
   52 |   return newItem.id;
   53 | }
   54 | 
   55 | export async function processQueue(
   56 |   executor: (item: QueuedMutationItem) => Promise<void>
   57 | ): Promise<{ processed: number; failed: number }> {
   58 |   const queue = getLocalMutationQueue();
   59 |   if (queue.length === 0) return { processed: 0, failed: 0 };
   60 | 
   61 |   let processedCount = 0;
   62 |   let failedCount = 0;
   63 |   const remainingQueue: QueuedMutationItem[] = [];
   64 | 
   65 |   for (const item of queue) {
   66 |     try {
   67 |       await executor(item);
   68 |       processedCount++;
   69 |     } catch (err) {
   70 |       console.warn(`[OfflineQueue] Failed to replay mutation ${item.id}, retaining in queue:`, err);
   71 |       failedCount++;
   72 |       remainingQueue.push(item);
   73 |       // Stop on first failure to preserve sequence integrity
   74 |       const unattempted = queue.slice(queue.indexOf(item) + 1);
   75 |       remainingQueue.push(...unattempted);
   76 |       break;
   77 |     }
   78 |   }
   79 | 
   80 |   saveLocalMutationQueue(remainingQueue);
   81 |   return { processed: processedCount, failed: failedCount };
   82 | }
   83 | 
   84 | // Global window event listener when device reconnects
   85 | export function startOfflineListener(executor: (item: QueuedMutationItem) => Promise<void>) {
   86 |   if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
   87 | 
   88 |   const handleOnline = async () => {
   89 |     console.log('[OfflineQueue] Device returned ONLINE. Replaying queued mutations...');
   90 |     const result = await processQueue(executor);
   91 |     if (result.processed > 0) {
   92 |       console.log(`[OfflineQueue] Successfully synced ${result.processed} mutations.`);
   93 |     }
   94 |   };
   95 | 
   96 |   window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
   97 |   return () => window.removeEventListener('online', handleOnline);
   98 | }
   99 |

   44 | const STORAGE_KEY = 'pulse_outbox_v1';
   45 | const listeners = new Set<(count: number) => void>();
   46 | 
   47 | function notifyListeners(count: number) {
   48 |   listeners.forEach((cb) => {
   49 |     try {
   50 |       cb(count);
   51 |     } catch (e) {
   52 |       console.warn('Error in outbox listener:', e);
   53 |     }
   54 |   });
   55 | }
   56 | 
   57 | export function onOutboxChange(callback: (count: number) => void) {
   58 |   listeners.add(callback);
   59 |   readOutbox().then((ops) => callback(ops.length));
   60 |   return () => {
   61 |     listeners.delete(callback);
   62 |   };
   63 | }
   64 | 
   65 | export async function readOutbox(): Promise<OutboxOp[]> {
   66 |   try {
   67 |     const data = await get<OutboxOp[]>(STORAGE_KEY);
   68 |     return Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
   69 |   } catch (err) {
   70 |     console.warn('Could not read from IndexedDB, trying localStorage fallback:', err);
   71 |     try {
   72 |       const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
   73 |       return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
   74 |     } catch {
   75 |       return [];
   76 |     }
   77 |   }
   78 | }
   79 | 
   80 | export async function writeOutbox(ops: OutboxOp[]) {
   81 |   try {
   82 |     await set(STORAGE_KEY, ops);
   83 |   } catch (err) {
   84 |     console.warn('Could not write to IndexedDB, fallback to localStorage:', err);
   85 |     try {
   86 |       localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(ops));
   87 |     } catch {}
   88 |   }
   89 |   notifyListeners(ops.length);
   90 | }
   91 | 
   92 | export async function enqueue(op: OutboxOp) {
   93 |   const ops = await readOutbox();
   94 |   ops.push(op);
   95 |   await writeOutbox(ops);
   96 |   return op;
   97 | }
   98 | 
   99 | export async function updateOp(id: string, patch: Partial<OutboxOp>) {
  100 |   const ops = await readOutbox();
  101 |   const next = ops.map((o) => (o.id === id ? ({ ...o, ...patch } as OutboxOp) : o));
  102 |   await writeOutbox(next);
  103 | }
  104 | 
  105 | export async function removeOp(id: string) {
  106 |   const ops = await readOutbox();
  107 |   const remaining = ops.filter((o) => o.id !== id);
  108 |   await writeOutbox(remaining);
  109 | }

    6 | export async function submitRegisterEntry(input: {
    7 |   entryType: 'new' | 'renewal' | 'balance' | 'freeze';
    8 |   fullName: string;
    9 |   phone: string;
   10 |   gender?: string | null;
   11 |   months?: number | null;
   12 |   freezeDays?: number | null;
   13 |   amount: number;
   14 |   method: string;
   15 |   listPrice?: number | null;
   16 |   branchId?: string | null;
   17 |   notes?: string | null;
   18 | }) {
   19 |   const phone = normalizePhone10(input.phone);
   20 |   if (!phone) throw new Error('INVALID_PHONE');
   21 | 
   22 |   // Stable key: same logical desk line retries safely
   23 |   const keyPrefix = [
   24 |     'reg',
   25 |     input.entryType,
   26 |     phone,
   27 |     input.amount.toFixed(2),
   28 |     input.method,
   29 |     input.months ?? input.freezeDays ?? '',
   30 |   ].join(':');
   31 | 
   32 |   const isOnline = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true;
   33 | 
   34 |   const payload = {
   35 |     p_entry_type: input.entryType,
   36 |     p_full_name: input.fullName,
   37 |     p_phone: phone,
   38 |     p_gender: input.gender ?? null,
   39 |     p_months: input.months ?? null,
   40 |     p_freeze_days: input.entryType === 'freeze' ? 30 : input.freezeDays ?? null,
   41 |     p_amount: input.amount,
   42 |     p_method: input.method,
   43 |     p_list_price: input.listPrice ?? null,
   44 |     p_branch_id: input.branchId ?? null,
   45 |     p_notes: input.notes ?? null,
   46 |     p_idempotency_key:
   47 |       typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && !isOnline
   48 |         ? `${keyPrefix}:${crypto.randomUUID()}`
   49 |         : `${keyPrefix}:${Math.floor(Date.now() / 30_000)}`,
   50 |   };
   51 | 
   52 |   if (!isOnline) {
   53 |     await enqueue({
   54 |       id: typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : `op_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}`,
   55 |       type: 'register_day_entry',
   56 |       createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
   57 |       status: 'pending',
   58 |       attempts: 0,
   59 |       payload,
   60 |     });
   61 |     return { queued: true as const, balance_due: 0, balance_after: 0 };
   62 |   }
   63 | 
   64 |   const result = await callRpc<any>('register_day_entry', payload, {
   65 |     context: 'register_day_entry',
   66 |   });
   67 |   return { queued: false as const, ...result };

    1 | // src/lib/offline/syncEngine.ts
    2 | import { callRpc } from '../rpc';
    3 | import { readOutbox, updateOp, removeOp, type OutboxOp } from './outbox';
    4 | import { toast } from '../toast';
    5 | 
    6 | let running = false;
    7 | const syncListeners = new Set<(isSyncing: boolean) => void>();
    8 | 
    9 | export function onSyncStateChange(callback: (isSyncing: boolean) => void) {
   10 |   syncListeners.add(callback);
   11 |   callback(running);
   12 |   return () => {
   13 |     syncListeners.delete(callback);
   14 |   };
   15 | }
   16 | 
   17 | function setRunning(val: boolean) {
   18 |   running = val;
   19 |   syncListeners.forEach((fn) => fn(val));
   20 | }
   21 | 
   22 | async function processOne(op: OutboxOp) {
   23 |   await updateOp(op.id, { status: 'syncing', attempts: op.attempts + 1 });
   24 | 
   25 |   if (op.type === 'register_day_entry') {
   26 |     await callRpc('register_day_entry', op.payload, {
   27 |       context: 'outbox_register',
   28 |     });
   29 |   } else if (op.type === 'check_in') {
   30 |     await callRpc('check_in_with_override', {
   31 |       p_member_id: op.payload.member_id,
   32 |       p_notes: op.payload.notes || 'Offline QR Check-in sync',
   33 |       p_promise_preset: op.payload.promise_preset || null,
   34 |       p_actor_id: op.payload.actor_id || null,
   35 |       p_day_key: op.payload.day_key,
   36 |     }, { context: 'outbox_checkin' });
   37 |   }
   38 | 
   39 |   await removeOp(op.id);
   40 | }
   41 | 
   42 | export async function flushOutbox() {
   43 |   if (running) return;
   44 |   if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !navigator.onLine) return;
   45 | 
   46 |   const ops = await readOutbox();
   47 |   if (ops.length === 0) return;
   48 | 
   49 |   setRunning(true);
   50 |   let syncedCount = 0;
   51 | 
   52 |   try {
   53 |     for (const op of ops) {
   54 |       if (op.status === 'syncing' && op.attempts > 5) continue;
   55 |       try {
   56 |         await processOne(op);
   57 |         syncedCount++;
   58 |       } catch (e: any) {
   59 |         const msg = String(e?.message || e);
   60 |         // Permanent failures: drop or mark failed
   61 |         if (
   62 |           /INVALID_PHONE|FORBIDDEN|MEMBER_NOT_FOUND|ALREADY_CHECKED_IN|VALIDATION/i.test(msg)
   63 |         ) {
   64 |           console.warn(`[Sync] Permanent failure for op ${op.id}:`, msg);
   65 |           await updateOp(op.id, {
   66 |             status: 'failed',
   67 |             lastError: msg,
   68 |           });
   69 |           // Remove permanently failed op after 3 attempts
   70 |           if (op.attempts >= 3) {
   71 |             await removeOp(op.id);
   72 |           }
   73 |           continue;
   74 |         }
   75 | 
   76 |         await updateOp(op.id, {
   77 |           status: 'pending',
   78 |           lastError: msg,
   79 |         });
   80 | 
   81 |         // Stop batch on transient network disconnect
   82 |         if (/NETWORK|fetch|Load failed|Failed to fetch/i.test(msg)) {
   83 |           break;
   84 |         }
   85 |       }
   86 |     }
   87 | 
   88 |     if (syncedCount > 0) {
   89 |       toast.success(`Synced ${syncedCount} queued action(s) with server!`);
   90 |     }
   91 |   } finally {
   92 |     setRunning(false);
   93 |   }
   94 | }
   95 | 
   96 | export function startOutboxListener() {
   97 |   if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
   98 | 
   99 |   window.addEventListener('online', () => {
  100 |     console.info('[Sync] Network connection restored. Flushing outbox...');
  101 |     void flushOutbox();
  102 |   });
  103 | 
  104 |   document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
  105 |     if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && navigator.onLine) {
  106 |       void flushOutbox();
  107 |     }
  108 |   });
  109 | 
  110 |   // Background interval check
  111 |   setInterval(() => {
  112 |     if (navigator.onLine) {
  113 |       void flushOutbox();
  114 |     }
  115 |   }, 25_000);
  116 | }

   61 | function parseCsv(text: string): string[][] {
   62 |   const rows: string[][] = [];
   63 |   let row: string[] = [];
   64 |   let cur = '';
   65 |   let inQuotes = false;
   66 |   for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
   67 |     const c = text[i];
   68 |     const next = text[i + 1];
   69 |     if (inQuotes) {
   70 |       if (c === '"' && next === '"') {
   71 |         cur += '"';
   72 |         i++;
   73 |       } else if (c === '"') inQuotes = false;
   74 |       else cur += c;
   75 |     } else if (c === '"') inQuotes = true;
   76 |     else if (c === ',') {
   77 |       row.push(cur.trim());
   78 |       cur = '';
   79 |     } else if (c === '\n' || c === '\r') {
   80 |       if (c === '\r' && next === '\n') i++;
   81 |       row.push(cur.trim());
   82 |       if (row.some((x) => x !== '')) rows.push(row);
   83 |       row = [];
   84 |       cur = '';
   85 |     } else cur += c;
   86 |   }
   87 |   row.push(cur.trim());
   88 |   if (row.some((x) => x !== '')) rows.push(row);
   89 |   return rows;
   90 | }
   91 | 
   92 | function parseDate(v: string): string | null {
   93 |   if (!v) return null;
   94 |   if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) return v;
   95 |   const m = v.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{4})$/);
   96 |   if (m) return `${m[3]}-${m[2].padStart(2, '0')}-${m[1].padStart(2, '0')}`;
   97 |   return null;
   98 | }

  112 | 
  113 |   if (!text?.trim()) {
  114 |     return { valid: [], errors: [{ rowNumber: 0, message: 'File is empty' }], totalRows: 0 };
  115 |   }
  116 | 
  117 |   const matrix = parseCsv(text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''));
  118 |   if (matrix.length < 2) {
  119 |     return {
  120 |       valid: [],
  121 |       errors: [{ rowNumber: 0, message: 'Need header + at least one data row' }],
  122 |       totalRows: 0,
  123 |     };
  124 |   }
  125 | 
  126 |   const headers = matrix[0].map((h) => HEADER_MAP[normHeader(h)] || normHeader(h));
  127 |   if (!headers.includes('phone') || !headers.includes('amount') || !headers.includes('method')) {
  128 |     return {
  129 |       valid: [],
  130 |       errors: [{ rowNumber: 0, message: 'Required columns: phone, amount, method' }],
  131 |       totalRows: matrix.length - 1,
  132 |     };
  133 |   }
  134 | 
  135 |   const hasType = headers.includes('entry_type');
  136 | 
  137 |   for (let i = 1; i < matrix.length; i++) {
  138 |     const rowNumber = i + 1;
  139 |     const raw: Record<string, string> = {};
  140 |     headers.forEach((h, idx) => {
  141 |       raw[h] = (matrix[i][idx] ?? '').trim();
  142 |     });
  143 | 
  144 |     const phone = normalizePhone10(raw.phone || '');
  145 |     if (!phone || !isValidIndianMobile10(phone)) {
  146 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'phone', message: 'Invalid 10-digit Indian mobile' });
  147 |       continue;
  148 |     }
  149 | 
  150 |     const amount = Number(raw.amount);
  151 |     if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) {
  152 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'amount', message: 'amount must be > 0' });
  153 |       continue;
  154 |     }
  155 | 
  156 |     let method = (raw.method || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_');
  157 |     if (['gpay', 'google_pay', 'phonepe', 'bhim', 'paytm'].includes(method)) method = 'upi';
  158 |     if (!METHODS.has(method)) {
  159 |       errors.push({
  160 |         rowNumber,
  161 |         field: 'method',
  162 |         message: 'method must be upi, cash, card, or bank_transfer',
  163 |       });
  164 |       continue;
  165 |     }
  166 | 
  167 |     let entry_type = (hasType ? raw.entry_type || 'balance' : 'balance').toLowerCase().trim();
  168 |     if (entry_type === 'n') entry_type = 'new';
  169 |     if (entry_type === 'r') entry_type = 'renewal';
  170 |     if (entry_type === 'b') entry_type = 'balance';
  171 |     if (!ENTRY_TYPES.has(entry_type)) {
  172 |       errors.push({
  173 |         rowNumber,
  174 |         field: 'entry_type',
  175 |         message: 'entry_type must be new, renewal, or balance (or N/R/B)',
  176 |       });
  177 |       continue;
  178 |     }
  179 | 
  180 |     let entry_date = raw.entry_date ? parseDate(raw.entry_date) : todayIST();
  181 |     if (raw.entry_date && !entry_date) {
  182 |       errors.push({
  183 |         rowNumber,
  184 |         field: 'entry_date',
  185 |         message: 'Use YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY',
  186 |       });
  187 |       continue;
  188 |     }
  189 | 
  190 |     let months: number | null = null;
  191 |     if (raw.months) {
  192 |       months = Number(raw.months);
  193 |       if (!Number.isInteger(months) || months < 1 || months > 12) {
  194 |         errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'months', message: 'months 1–12' });
  195 |         continue;
  196 |       }
  197 |     }
  198 | 
  199 |     let list_price: number | null = null;
  200 |     if (raw.list_price) {
  201 |       list_price = Number(raw.list_price);
  202 |       if (!Number.isFinite(list_price) || list_price < 0) {
  203 |         errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'list_price', message: 'Invalid list_price' });
  204 |         continue;
  205 |       }
  206 |     }
  207 | 
  208 |     const idempotency_key =
  209 |       raw.idempotency_key ||
  210 |       `imp:${phone}:${amount}:${method}:${entry_type}:${entry_date}:${rowNumber}`;
  211 | 
  212 |     if (seenKeys.has(idempotency_key)) {
  213 |       errors.push({ rowNumber, field: 'idempotency_key', message: 'Duplicate key in file' });
  214 |       continue;
  215 |     }
  216 |     seenKeys.add(idempotency_key);
  217 | 
  218 |     valid.push({
  219 |       rowNumber,
  220 |       phone,
  221 |       amount,
  222 |       method: method as PaymentImportValid['method'],
  223 |       entry_type: entry_type as PaymentImportValid['entry_type'],
  224 |       entry_date: entry_date!,
  225 |       reference: raw.reference || null,
  226 |       notes: raw.notes || null,
  227 |       package_type: raw.package_type || null,
  228 |       list_price,
  229 |       months,
  230 |       full_name: raw.full_name || null,
  231 |       idempotency_key,
  232 |     });
  233 |   }
  234 | 
  235 |   return { valid, errors, totalRows: matrix.length - 1 };
  236 | }
  237 |

FILE [36/107]: src/lib/payments.ts (61 lines)

    1 | // src/lib/payments.ts
    2 | import { parseResponseJson } from './apiUtils';
    3 | 
    4 | export function makePaymentIdempotencyKey(parts: {
    5 |   memberId: string;
    6 |   amount: number;
    7 |   method: string;
    8 |   // bucket to 30s window so double-clicks collide, intentional retries can pass new key
    9 |   windowMs?: number;
   10 | }) {
   11 |   const window = parts.windowMs ?? 30_000;
   12 |   const bucket = Math.floor(Date.now() / window);
   13 |   // Stable for double-submit; change if user deliberately pays again later
   14 |   return [
   15 |     'pay',
   16 |     parts.memberId,
   17 |     Number(parts.amount).toFixed(2),
   18 |     parts.method,
   19 |     bucket,
   20 |   ].join(':');
   21 | }
   22 | 
   23 | export async function recordPayment(input: {
   24 |   memberId: string;
   25 |   branchId: string;
   26 |   amount: number;
   27 |   method: string;
   28 |   reference?: string;
   29 |   packageType?: string;
   30 |   recordedBy?: string;
   31 | }) {
   32 |   const idempotency_key = makePaymentIdempotencyKey({
   33 |     memberId: input.memberId,
   34 |     amount: input.amount,
   35 |     method: input.method,
   36 |   });
   37 | 
   38 |   const res = await fetch('/api/payments', {
   39 |     method: 'POST',
   40 |     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   41 |     body: JSON.stringify({
   42 |       member_id: input.memberId,
   43 |       branch_id: input.branchId,
   44 |       amount: input.amount,
   45 |       method: input.method,
   46 |       reference: input.reference ?? null,
   47 |       package_type: input.packageType ?? null,
   48 |       recorded_by: input.recordedBy,
   49 |       idempotency_key, // hidden from UI
   50 |     }),
   51 |   });
   52 | 
   53 |   const data = await parseResponseJson<any>(res, {});
   54 | 
   55 |   if (!res.ok) {
   56 |     throw new Error(data.error || 'Payment recording failed');
   57 |   }
   58 | 
   59 |   return data;
   60 | }

  313 |   email TEXT,
  314 |   balance_due NUMERIC,
  315 |   end_date DATE,
  316 |   status TEXT,
  317 |   days_overdue INT
  318 | )
  319 | LANGUAGE plpgsql
  320 | STABLE
  321 | SECURITY DEFINER
  322 | SET search_path = public
  323 | AS $$
  324 | BEGIN
  325 |   RETURN QUERY
  326 |   SELECT
  327 |     m.id,
  328 |     m.branch_id,
  329 |     m.full_name,
  330 |     m.phone,
  331 |     m.email,
  332 |     m.balance_due,
  333 |     m.end_date,
  334 |     m.status,
  335 |     GREATEST(
  336 |       0,
  337 |       (timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()))::date - COALESCE(
  338 |         (SELECT MAX(p.entry_date) FROM public.payments p
  339 |          WHERE p.member_id = m.id AND p.entry_type = 'balance'),
  340 |         m.start_date,
  341 |         (timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()))::date
  342 |       )
  343 |     )::int AS days_overdue
  344 |   FROM public.members m
  345 |   LEFT JOIN public.balance_reminder_settings s ON s.branch_id = m.branch_id
  346 |   WHERE COALESCE(s.enabled, true) = true
  347 |     AND COALESCE(m.is_archived, false) = false
  348 |     AND COALESCE(m.balance_due, 0) >= COALESCE(p_min_balance, s.min_balance, 1)
  349 |     AND (
  350 |       m.status = 'active'
  351 |       OR (COALESCE(s.include_expired, false) AND m.status = 'expired')
  352 |     )
  353 |     AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR m.branch_id = p_branch_id)
  354 |     AND m.phone IS NOT NULL
  355 |     AND length(regexp_replace(m.phone, '\D', '', 'g')) >= 10
  356 |     AND NOT EXISTS (
  357 |       SELECT 1 FROM public.balance_reminder_log l
  358 |       WHERE l.member_id = m.id
  359 |         AND l.status = 'sent'
  360 |         AND l.created_at >= now() - make_interval(
  361 |           days => COALESCE(p_cooldown_days, s.cooldown_days, 3)
  362 |         )
  363 |     )
  364 |   ORDER BY m.balance_due DESC, m.full_name;
  365 | END;
  366 | $$;
  367 | 
  368 | GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.list_balance_reminder_targets TO authenticated;
  369 | 
  370 | -- ============================================================
  371 | -- 2) Single Day Register Entry RPC (N / R / B)
  372 | -- ============================================================
  373 | 
  374 | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_day_entry(
  375 |   p_entry_type TEXT,
  376 |   p_full_name TEXT,
  377 |   p_phone TEXT,
  378 |   p_gender TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  379 |   p_months INT DEFAULT NULL,
  380 |   p_freeze_days INT DEFAULT NULL,
  381 |   p_amount NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
  382 |   p_method TEXT DEFAULT 'upi',
  383 |   p_list_price NUMERIC DEFAULT NULL,
  384 |   p_branch_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
  385 |   p_notes TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  386 |   p_idempotency_key TEXT DEFAULT NULL
  387 | )
  388 | RETURNS JSONB
  389 | LANGUAGE plpgsql
  390 | SECURITY DEFINER
  391 | SET search_path = public
  392 | AS $$
  393 | DECLARE
  394 |   me RECORD;
  395 |   phone10 TEXT;
  396 |   member_id UUID;
  397 |   branch UUID;
  398 |   today DATE := (timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()))::date;
  399 |   new_end DATE;
  400 |   balance NUMERIC;
  401 |   pay_id UUID;
  402 |   start_d DATE;
  403 |   list_price NUMERIC;
  404 |   cur_end DATE;
  405 |   freeze_days INT;
  406 |   sub_months INT;
  407 |   pkg_name TEXT;
  408 |   mem_status TEXT;
  409 | BEGIN
  410 |   SELECT id, role, branch_id INTO me FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid();
  411 |   IF me.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTH_SESSION_MISSING'; END IF;
  412 |   IF me.role NOT IN ('super_owner', 'owner', 'branch_manager', 'trainer') THEN
  413 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN';
  414 |   END IF;
  415 | 
  416 |   IF p_entry_type NOT IN ('new', 'renewal', 'balance', 'freeze') THEN
  417 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_ENTRY_TYPE';
  418 |   END IF;
  419 |   IF p_entry_type <> 'freeze' AND (p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount < 0) THEN
  420 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_AMOUNT';
  421 |   END IF;
  422 | 
  423 |   -- Idempotent payment replay
  424 |   IF p_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL THEN
  425 |     SELECT id, member_id INTO pay_id, member_id
  426 |     FROM public.payments WHERE idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;
  427 |     IF pay_id IS NOT NULL THEN
  428 |       SELECT balance_due INTO balance FROM public.members WHERE id = member_id;
  429 |       RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  430 |         'member_id', member_id,
  431 |         'payment_id', pay_id,
  432 |         'entry_type', p_entry_type,
  433 |         'balance_due', balance,
  434 |         'replayed', true
  435 |       );
  436 |     END IF;
  437 |   END IF;
  438 | 
  439 |   phone10 := right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(p_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 10);
  440 |   IF length(phone10) <> 10 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_PHONE'; END IF;
  441 | 
  442 |   branch := COALESCE(p_branch_id, me.branch_id);
  443 |   IF branch IS NULL AND me.role <> 'super_owner' THEN
  444 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'BRANCH_REQUIRED';
  445 |   END IF;
  446 | 
  447 |   IF me.role <> 'super_owner' AND branch IS DISTINCT FROM me.branch_id THEN
  448 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN_BRANCH';
  449 |   END IF;
  450 | 
  451 |   SELECT id INTO member_id
  452 |   FROM public.members
  453 |   WHERE right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 10) = phone10
  454 |     AND COALESCE(is_archived, false) = false
  455 |     AND branch_id = branch
  456 |   ORDER BY created_at DESC
  457 |   LIMIT 1;
  458 | 
  459 |   list_price := COALESCE(p_list_price, p_amount, 0);
  460 | 
  461 |   IF p_entry_type = 'new' THEN
  462 |     IF p_months IS NULL OR p_months < 1 OR p_months > 12 THEN
  463 |       RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_MONTHS';
  464 |     END IF;
  465 |     IF trim(COALESCE(p_full_name, '')) = '' THEN
  466 |       RAISE EXCEPTION 'NAME_REQUIRED';
  467 |     END IF;
  468 | 
  469 |     start_d := today;
  470 |     new_end := (today + (p_months || ' months')::interval)::date;
  471 |     balance := GREATEST(0, list_price - p_amount);
  472 | 
  473 |     IF member_id IS NULL THEN
  474 |       INSERT INTO public.members (
  475 |         full_name, phone, gender, status, branch_id,
  476 |         start_date, end_date, subscription_months,
  477 |         amount_paid, balance_due, onboarded_by
  478 |       ) VALUES (
  479 |         trim(p_full_name), phone10, p_gender, 'active', branch,
  480 |         start_d, new_end, p_months,
  481 |         p_amount, balance, me.id
  482 |       ) RETURNING id INTO member_id;
  483 |     ELSE
  484 |       UPDATE public.members SET
  485 |         full_name = trim(p_full_name),
  486 |         gender = COALESCE(p_gender, gender),
  487 |         status = 'active',
  488 |         start_date = start_d,
  489 |         end_date = new_end,
  490 |         subscription_months = p_months,
  491 |         amount_paid = COALESCE(amount_paid, 0) + p_amount,
  492 |         balance_due = balance,
  493 |         updated_at = now()
  494 |       WHERE id = member_id;
  495 |     END IF;
  496 | 
  497 |   ELSIF p_entry_type = 'renewal' THEN
  498 |     IF member_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MEMBER_NOT_FOUND'; END IF;
  499 |     IF p_months IS NULL OR p_months < 1 OR p_months > 12 THEN
  500 |       RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_MONTHS';
  501 |     END IF;
  502 | 
  503 |     SELECT end_date INTO cur_end FROM public.members WHERE id = member_id FOR UPDATE;
  504 |     start_d := CASE WHEN cur_end IS NOT NULL AND cur_end >= today THEN cur_end ELSE today END;
  505 |     new_end := (start_d + (p_months || ' months')::interval)::date;
  506 |     balance := GREATEST(0, list_price - p_amount);
  507 | 
  508 |     UPDATE public.members SET
  509 |       full_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_full_name), ''), full_name),
  510 |       status = 'active',
  511 |       end_date = new_end,
  512 |       subscription_months = p_months,
  513 |       amount_paid = COALESCE(amount_paid, 0) + p_amount,
  514 |       balance_due = balance,
  515 |       updated_at = now()
  516 |     WHERE id = member_id;
  517 | 
  518 |   ELSIF p_entry_type = 'freeze' THEN
  519 |     IF member_id IS NULL THEN
  520 |       RAISE EXCEPTION 'MEMBER_NOT_FOUND';
  521 |     END IF;
  522 | 
  523 |     -- Fixed: exactly one month (30 days). Ignore client p_freeze_days / p_months.
  524 |     freeze_days := 30;
  525 | 
  526 |     SELECT
  527 |       end_date,
  528 |       subscription_months,
  529 |       lower(COALESCE(package_type, '')),
  530 |       status
  531 |     INTO cur_end, sub_months, pkg_name, mem_status
  532 |     FROM public.members
  533 |     WHERE id = member_id
  534 |     FOR UPDATE;
  535 | 
  536 |     IF mem_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active' THEN
  537 |       RAISE EXCEPTION 'CANNOT_FREEZE_INACTIVE';
  538 |     END IF;
  539 | 
  540 |     IF cur_end IS NULL OR cur_end < today THEN
  541 |       RAISE EXCEPTION 'CANNOT_FREEZE_EXPIRED';
  542 |     END IF;
  543 | 
  544 |     -- Annual package only (12 months or package name contains annual/year)
  545 |     IF NOT (
  546 |       COALESCE(sub_months, 0) = 12
  547 |       OR pkg_name LIKE '%annual%'
  548 |       OR pkg_name LIKE '%year%'
  549 |     ) THEN
  550 |       RAISE EXCEPTION 'FREEZE_ANNUAL_ONLY';
  551 |     END IF;
  552 | 
  553 |     new_end := (cur_end + (freeze_days || ' days')::interval)::date;
  554 | 
  555 |     UPDATE public.members SET
  556 |       end_date = new_end,
  557 |       notes = trim(concat_ws(' ', notes, '[Frozen 30d (Annual) on ' || today::text || ']')),
  558 |       updated_at = now()
  559 |     WHERE id = member_id
  560 |     RETURNING balance_due INTO balance;
  561 | 
  562 |   ELSE
  563 |     -- B: balance collection only
  564 |     IF member_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MEMBER_NOT_FOUND'; END IF;
  565 |     IF p_amount <= 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_AMOUNT'; END IF;
  566 | 
  567 |     UPDATE public.members SET
  568 |       balance_due = GREATEST(0, COALESCE(balance_due, 0) - p_amount),
  569 |       amount_paid = COALESCE(amount_paid, 0) + p_amount,
  570 |       updated_at = now()
  571 |     WHERE id = member_id
  572 |     RETURNING balance_due INTO balance;
  573 |   END IF;
  574 | 
  575 |   IF p_amount > 0 THEN
  576 |     INSERT INTO public.payments (
  577 |       member_id, branch_id, amount, method,
  578 |       entry_type, entry_date, recorded_by, notes, idempotency_key
  579 |     ) VALUES (
  580 |       member_id, branch, p_amount, lower(p_method),
  581 |       p_entry_type, today, me.id, p_notes, p_idempotency_key
  582 |     )
  583 |     RETURNING id INTO pay_id;
  584 |   END IF;
  585 | 
  586 |   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  587 |     'member_id', member_id,
  588 |     'payment_id', pay_id,
  589 |     'entry_type', p_entry_type,
  590 |     'balance_due', balance,
  591 |     'end_date', new_end,
  592 |     'freeze_days', CASE WHEN p_entry_type = 'freeze' THEN freeze_days ELSE NULL END,
  593 |     'replayed', false
  594 |   );
  595 | END;
  596 | $$;
  597 | 
  598 | GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.register_day_entry TO authenticated;

  600 | -- Fast eligibility check for UI phone validation
  601 | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.member_freeze_eligible(
  602 |   p_phone TEXT,
  603 |   p_branch_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
  604 | )
  605 | RETURNS JSONB
  606 | LANGUAGE plpgsql
  607 | SECURITY DEFINER
  608 | SET search_path = public
  609 | AS $$
  610 | DECLARE
  611 |   phone10 TEXT;
  612 |   today DATE := (timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()))::date;
  613 |   m RECORD;
  614 |   is_annual BOOLEAN;
  615 |   projected_end DATE;
  616 | BEGIN
  617 |   phone10 := right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(p_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 10);
  618 |   IF length(phone10) <> 10 THEN
  619 |     RETURN jsonb_build_object('eligible', false, 'reason', 'INVALID_PHONE');
  620 |   END IF;
  621 | 
  622 |   SELECT id, full_name, end_date, subscription_months, lower(COALESCE(package_type, '')) AS pkg, status
  623 |   INTO m
  624 |   FROM public.members
  625 |   WHERE right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 10) = phone10
  626 |     AND COALESCE(is_archived, false) = false
  627 |     AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR branch_id = p_branch_id)
  628 |   ORDER BY created_at DESC
  629 |   LIMIT 1;
  630 | 
  631 |   IF m.id IS NULL THEN
  632 |     RETURN jsonb_build_object('eligible', false, 'reason', 'MEMBER_NOT_FOUND');
  633 |   END IF;
  634 | 
  635 |   IF m.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active' THEN
  636 |     RETURN jsonb_build_object('eligible', false, 'reason', 'NOT_ACTIVE', 'member_id', m.id);
  637 |   END IF;
  638 | 
  639 |   IF m.end_date IS NULL OR m.end_date < today THEN
  640 |     RETURN jsonb_build_object('eligible', false, 'reason', 'EXPIRED', 'member_id', m.id, 'end_date', m.end_date);
  641 |   END IF;
  642 | 
  643 |   is_annual := (COALESCE(m.subscription_months, 0) = 12 OR m.pkg LIKE '%annual%' OR m.pkg LIKE '%year%');
  644 |   IF NOT is_annual THEN
  645 |     RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  646 |       'eligible', false,
  647 |       'reason', 'NOT_ANNUAL',
  648 |       'member_id', m.id,
  649 |       'full_name', m.full_name,
  650 |       'subscription_months', m.subscription_months
  651 |     );
  652 |   END IF;
  653 | 
  654 |   projected_end := (m.end_date + '30 days'::interval)::date;
  655 | 
  656 |   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  657 |     'eligible', true,
  658 |     'member_id', m.id,
  659 |     'full_name', m.full_name,
  660 |     'current_end_date', m.end_date,
  661 |     'projected_end_date', projected_end,
  662 |     'freeze_days', 30
  663 |   );
  664 | END;
  665 | $$;
  666 | 
  667 | GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.member_freeze_eligible TO authenticated;

  709 | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_check_in(
  710 |   p_staff_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  711 |   p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  712 |   p_method text DEFAULT 'manual',
  713 |   p_notes text DEFAULT NULL
  714 | )
  715 | RETURNS jsonb
  716 | LANGUAGE plpgsql
  717 | SECURITY DEFINER
  718 | SET search_path = public
  719 | AS $
  720 | DECLARE
  721 |   me record;
  722 |   target uuid;
  723 |   branch uuid;
  724 |   row_id uuid;
  725 | BEGIN
  726 |   SELECT id, role, branch_id INTO me FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid();
  727 |   IF me.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTH_SESSION_MISSING'; END IF;
  728 | 
  729 |   target := COALESCE(p_staff_id, me.id);
  730 | 
  731 |   IF target IS DISTINCT FROM me.id
  732 |      AND me.role NOT IN ('super_owner', 'owner', 'branch_manager') THEN
  733 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN';
  734 |   END IF;
  735 | 
  736 |   SELECT branch_id INTO branch FROM profiles WHERE id = target;
  737 |   branch := COALESCE(p_branch_id, branch, me.branch_id);
  738 |   IF branch IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BRANCH_REQUIRED'; END IF;
  739 | 
  740 |   IF me.role IN ('owner', 'branch_manager')
  741 |      AND me.role <> 'super_owner'
  742 |      AND me.branch_id IS DISTINCT FROM branch THEN
  743 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN_BRANCH';
  744 |   END IF;
  745 | 
  746 |   IF EXISTS (
  747 |     SELECT 1 FROM staff_attendance
  748 |     WHERE staff_id = target AND checked_out_at IS NULL
  749 |   ) THEN
  750 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'ALREADY_CHECKED_IN';
  751 |   END IF;
  752 | 
  753 |   INSERT INTO staff_attendance (
  754 |     staff_id, branch_id, checked_in_at, method, notes, recorded_by
  755 |   ) VALUES (
  756 |     target,
  757 |     branch,
  758 |     now(),
  759 |     COALESCE(p_method, 'manual'),
  760 |     p_notes,
  761 |     me.id
  762 |   )
  763 |   RETURNING id INTO row_id;
  764 | 
  765 |   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  766 |     'id', row_id,
  767 |     'staff_id', target,
  768 |     'branch_id', branch,
  769 |     'checked_in_at', now()
  770 |   );
  771 | END;
  772 | $;
  773 | 
  774 | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_check_out(
  775 |   p_staff_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  776 |   p_notes text DEFAULT NULL
  777 | )
  778 | RETURNS jsonb
  779 | LANGUAGE plpgsql
  780 | SECURITY DEFINER
  781 | SET search_path = public
  782 | AS $
  783 | DECLARE
  784 |   me record;
  785 |   target uuid;
  786 |   open_row staff_attendance%ROWTYPE;
  787 | BEGIN
  788 |   SELECT id, role, branch_id INTO me FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid();
  789 |   IF me.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTH_SESSION_MISSING'; END IF;
  790 | 
  791 |   target := COALESCE(p_staff_id, me.id);
  792 | 
  793 |   IF target IS DISTINCT FROM me.id
  794 |      AND me.role NOT IN ('super_owner', 'owner', 'branch_manager') THEN
  795 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN';
  796 |   END IF;
  797 | 
  798 |   SELECT * INTO open_row
  799 |   FROM staff_attendance
  800 |   WHERE staff_id = target AND checked_out_at IS NULL
  801 |   ORDER BY checked_in_at DESC
  802 |   LIMIT 1
  803 |   FOR UPDATE;
  804 | 
  805 |   IF NOT FOUND THEN
  806 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'NO_OPEN_SHIFT';
  807 |   END IF;
  808 | 
  809 |   IF me.role IN ('owner', 'branch_manager')
  810 |      AND me.role <> 'super_owner'
  811 |      AND me.branch_id IS DISTINCT FROM open_row.branch_id THEN
  812 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN_BRANCH';
  813 |   END IF;
  814 | 
  815 |   UPDATE staff_attendance SET
  816 |     checked_out_at = now(),
  817 |     notes = CASE
  818 |       WHEN p_notes IS NULL THEN notes
  819 |       WHEN notes IS NULL THEN p_notes
  820 |       ELSE notes || ' | ' || p_notes
  821 |     END
  822 |   WHERE id = open_row.id;
  823 | 
  824 |   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  825 |     'id', open_row.id,
  826 |     'staff_id', target,
  827 |     'checked_in_at', open_row.checked_in_at,
  828 |     'checked_out_at', now()
  829 |   );
  830 | END;
  831 | $;
  832 | 
  833 | GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.staff_check_in TO authenticated;
  834 | GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.staff_check_out TO authenticated;
  835 | 
  836 | COMMIT;
  837 |

    1 | /**
    2 |  * Phone utilities for Pulse Fitness
    3 |  * Handles Indian phone number validation, E.164 normalization, and duplicate matching.
    4 |  */
    5 | 
    6 | export function normalizeIndianPhone(input: string): string {
    7 |   if (!input) return '';
    8 |   // Remove all non-digit characters
    9 |   let digits = input.replace(/\D/g, '');
   10 | 
   11 |   // If starts with 91 and has 12 digits, strip 91
   12 |   if (digits.length === 12 && digits.startsWith('91')) {
   13 |     digits = digits.slice(2);
   14 |   } else if (digits.length > 10 && digits.startsWith('0')) {
   15 |     // If starts with leading zero (e.g. 09876543210), strip zeros
   16 |     digits = digits.replace(/^0+/, '');
   17 |   }
   18 | 
   19 |   // If we have 10 digits, return formatted clean 10-digit number
   20 |   if (digits.length === 10) {
   21 |     return digits;
   22 |   }
   23 | 
   24 |   return digits;
   25 | }
   26 | 
   27 | export function formatPhoneDisplay(phoneStr: string): string {
   28 |   const clean = normalizeIndianPhone(phoneStr);
   29 |   if (clean.length === 10) {
   30 |     return `+91 ${clean.slice(0, 5)} ${clean.slice(5)}`;
   31 |   }
   32 |   return phoneStr;
   33 | }
   34 | 
   35 | export function isValidIndianMobile(phoneStr: string): boolean {
   36 |   const clean = normalizeIndianPhone(phoneStr);
   37 |   // Valid Indian mobile numbers are 10 digits starting with 6, 7, 8, or 9
   38 |   return /^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(clean);
   39 | }
   40 | 
   41 | export function arePhonesEqual(phone1: string, phone2: string): boolean {
   42 |   const norm1 = normalizeIndianPhone(phone1);
   43 |   const norm2 = normalizeIndianPhone(phone2);
   44 |   if (norm1 && norm2 && norm1 === norm2) return true;
   45 |   return false;
   46 | }

    3 |  * PWA Registration and BeforeInstallPrompt management for Pulse Fitness

    5 | 
    6 | export interface BeforeInstallPromptEvent extends Event {
    7 |   readonly platforms: string[];
    8 |   readonly userChoice: Promise<{
    9 |     outcome: 'accepted' | 'dismissed';
   10 |     platform: string;
   11 |   }>;
   12 |   prompt(): Promise<void>;
   13 | }
   14 | 
   15 | let deferredPrompt: BeforeInstallPromptEvent | null = null;
   16 | const installListeners = new Set<(canInstall: boolean) => void>();
   17 | 
   18 | export function registerServiceWorker() {
   19 |   if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return;
   20 | 
   21 |   // In DEV mode or iframe environment (e.g. AI Studio preview), unregister any active SW
   22 |   // to prevent interception of Vite dev server, HMR, and ephemeral modules
   23 |   if (Boolean((import.meta as any).env?.DEV) || window.self !== window.top) {
   24 |     navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then((registrations) => {
   25 |       for (const registration of registrations) {
   26 |         registration.unregister().catch(() => {});
   27 |       }
   28 |     }).catch(() => {});
   29 |     return;
   30 |   }
   31 | 
   32 |   window.addEventListener('load', () => {
   33 |     navigator.serviceWorker
   34 |       .register('/sw.js')
   35 |       .then((reg) => {
   36 |         console.info('[PWA] Service Worker registered with scope:', reg.scope);
   37 |       })
   38 |       .catch((err) => {
   39 |         console.warn('[PWA] Service Worker registration failed:', err);
   40 |       });
   41 |   });
   42 | 
   43 |   window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {
   44 |     e.preventDefault();
   45 |     deferredPrompt = e as BeforeInstallPromptEvent;
   46 |     installListeners.forEach((fn) => fn(true));
   47 |   });
   48 | 
   49 |   window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
   50 |     deferredPrompt = null;
   51 |     installListeners.forEach((fn) => fn(false));
   52 |     console.info('[PWA] Pulse Fitness installed successfully');
   53 |   });
   54 | }
   55 | 
   56 | export function onInstallAvailabilityChange(callback: (canInstall: boolean) => void) {
   57 |   installListeners.add(callback);
   58 |   callback(deferredPrompt !== null);
   59 |   return () => {
   60 |     installListeners.delete(callback);
   61 |   };
   62 | }
   63 | 
   64 | export async function promptPwaInstall(): Promise<boolean> {
   65 |   if (!deferredPrompt) {
   66 |     return false;
   67 |   }
   68 |   try {
   69 |     await deferredPrompt.prompt();
   70 |     const { outcome } = await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
   71 |     deferredPrompt = null;
   72 |     installListeners.forEach((fn) => fn(false));
   73 |     return outcome === 'accepted';
   74 |   } catch (err) {
   75 |     console.warn('[PWA] Install prompt error:', err);
   76 |     return false;
   77 |   }
   78 | }
   79 | 
   80 | export function isPwaInstalled(): boolean {
   81 |   if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
   82 |   return (
   83 |     window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
   84 |     (window.navigator as any).standalone === true ||
   85 |     document.referrer.includes('android-app://')
   86 |   );
   87 | }

FILE [42/107]: src/lib/retry.ts (61 lines)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    1 | // src/lib/retry.ts
    2 | 
    3 | export type RetryOpts = {
    4 |   maxAttempts?: number;
    5 |   baseDelayMs?: number;
    6 |   maxDelayMs?: number;
    7 |   shouldRetry?: (err: unknown, attempt: number) => boolean;
    8 | };
    9 | 
   10 | export function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
   11 |   return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
   12 | }
   13 | 
   14 | export function fullJitter(attempt: number, base: number, max: number): number {
   15 |   const exp = Math.min(max, base * 2 ** (attempt - 1));
   16 |   return Math.floor(Math.random() * exp);
   17 | }
   18 | 
   19 | export function isTransient(err: unknown): boolean {
   20 |   const e = err as any;
   21 |   const status = Number(e?.status || e?.statusCode || 0);
   22 |   const msg = String(e?.message || e || '').toLowerCase();
   23 |   const code = String(e?.code || '');
   24 | 
   25 |   if ([408, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(status)) return true;
   26 |   if (['RATE_LIMITED', 'MSG91_HTTP_ERROR', 'VAULT_READ_FAILED', 'NETWORK'].includes(code)) {
   27 |     return true;
   28 |   }
   29 |   if (/timeout|network|fetch|econnreset|temporar|unavailable|429|502|503/i.test(msg)) {
   30 |     return true;
   31 |   }
   32 |   // Never retry auth / validation / forbidden
   33 |   if ([400, 401, 403, 404, 422].includes(status)) return false;
   34 |   if (/AUTH_SESSION|FORBIDDEN|INVALID_|MSG91_AUTH_FAILED|DLT_TEMPLATE_MISSING/i.test(msg)) {
   35 |     return false;
   36 |   }
   37 |   return false;
   38 | }
   39 | 
   40 | export async function withRetry<T>(
   41 |   fn: (attempt: number) => Promise<T>,
   42 |   opts: RetryOpts = {}
   43 | ): Promise<T> {
   44 |   const max = opts.maxAttempts ?? 3;
   45 |   const base = opts.baseDelayMs ?? 400;
   46 |   const maxDelay = opts.maxDelayMs ?? 8000;
   47 |   const should = opts.shouldRetry ?? ((err) => isTransient(err));
   48 | 
   49 |   let last: unknown;
   50 |   for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= max; attempt++) {
   51 |     try {
   52 |       return await fn(attempt);
   53 |     } catch (err) {
   54 |       last = err;
   55 |       if (attempt >= max || !should(err, attempt)) break;
   56 |       await sleep(fullJitter(attempt, base, maxDelay));
   57 |     }
   58 |   }
   59 |   throw last;
   60 | }
   61 |

    1 | // src/lib/rpc.ts
    2 | import { toAppError, type AppErrorShape } from './errors';
    3 | import { parseResponseJson } from './apiUtils';
    4 | 
    5 | export class RpcError extends Error {
    6 |   shape: AppErrorShape;
    7 |   constructor(shape: AppErrorShape) {
    8 |     super(shape.message);
    9 |     this.name = 'RpcError';
   10 |     this.shape = shape;
   11 |   }
   12 | }
   13 | 
   14 | function sanitizeArgs(args?: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
   15 |   if (!args) return args;
   16 |   const clone = { ...args };
   17 |   for (const k of Object.keys(clone)) {
   18 |     if (/key|secret|password|token|auth/i.test(k)) {
   19 |       clone[k] = '[redacted]';
   20 |     }
   21 |   }
   22 |   return clone;
   23 | }
   24 | 
   25 | export async function callRpc<T>(
   26 |   fn: string,
   27 |   args?: Record<string, unknown>,
   28 |   opts?: { context?: string }
   29 | ): Promise<T> {
   30 |   try {
   31 |     const res = await fetch(`/api/rpc/${fn}`, {
   32 |       method: 'POST',
   33 |       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   34 |       body: JSON.stringify(args || {}),
   35 |     });
   36 | 
   37 |     const body = await parseResponseJson<any>(res, {});
   38 | 
   39 |     if (!res.ok) {
   40 |       const shape = toAppError({
   41 |         message: body.error || body.message || `RPC ${fn} failed (${res.status})`,
   42 |         status: res.status,
   43 |         code: body.code,
   44 |         details: body.details,
   45 |       });
   46 |       console.warn(`[RPC Error: ${opts?.context || fn}]`, {
   47 |         args: sanitizeArgs(args),
   48 |         shape,
   49 |       });
   50 |       throw new RpcError(shape);
   51 |     }
   52 | 
   53 |     return (body.data !== undefined ? body.data : body) as T;
   54 |   } catch (err) {
   55 |     if (err instanceof RpcError) throw err;
   56 |     const shape = toAppError(err);
   57 |     console.warn(`[RPC Failure: ${opts?.context || fn}]`, {
   58 |       args: sanitizeArgs(args),
   59 |       shape,
   60 |     });
   61 |     throw new RpcError(shape);
   62 |   }
   63 | }
   64 |

FILE [45/107]: src/lib/toast.ts (67 lines)

    1 | type ToastType = 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'message' | 'warning';
    2 | 
    3 | export interface ToastItem {
    4 |   id: string;
    5 |   type: ToastType;
    6 |   title: string;
    7 |   description?: string;
    8 |   duration?: number;
    9 | }
   10 | 
   11 | type ToastListener = (toasts: ToastItem[]) => void;
   12 | 
   13 | let toasts: ToastItem[] = [];
   14 | const listeners: Set<ToastListener> = new Set();
   15 | 
   16 | function notify() {
   17 |   listeners.forEach((fn) => fn([...toasts]));
   18 | }
   19 | 
   20 | export const toast = {
   21 |   success: (title: string, opts?: { description?: string; duration?: number }) => {
   22 |     toast.show('success', title, opts);
   23 |   },
   24 |   error: (title: string, opts?: { description?: string; duration?: number }) => {
   25 |     toast.show('error', title, opts);
   26 |   },
   27 |   warning: (title: string, opts?: { description?: string; duration?: number }) => {
   28 |     toast.show('warning', title, opts);
   29 |   },
   30 |   message: (title: string, opts?: { description?: string; duration?: number }) => {
   31 |     toast.show('info', title, opts);
   32 |   },
   33 |   info: (title: string, opts?: { description?: string; duration?: number }) => {
   34 |     toast.show('info', title, opts);
   35 |   },
   36 |   show: (type: ToastType, title: string, opts?: { description?: string; duration?: number }) => {
   37 |     const id = `toast_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
   38 |     const duration = opts?.duration ?? 4000;
   39 |     const item: ToastItem = {
   40 |       id,
   41 |       type,
   42 |       title,
   43 |       description: opts?.description,
   44 |       duration,
   45 |     };
   46 |     toasts = [item, ...toasts].slice(0, 5);
   47 |     notify();
   48 | 
   49 |     if (duration > 0) {
   50 |       setTimeout(() => {
   51 |         toast.dismiss(id);
   52 |       }, duration);
   53 |     }
   54 |   },
   55 |   dismiss: (id: string) => {
   56 |     toasts = toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id);
   57 |     notify();
   58 |   },
   59 |   subscribe: (fn: ToastListener) => {
   60 |     listeners.add(fn);
   61 |     fn([...toasts]);
   62 |     return () => {
   63 |       listeners.delete(fn);
   64 |     };
   65 |   },
   66 | };

    1 | // src/hooks/useExportMembersCsv.ts
    2 | import { useState } from 'react';
    3 | import { membersToCsv, downloadCsv, MemberCsvRow } from '../lib/exportMembersCsv';
    4 | import { Member, Branch, MemberExportFilter } from '../types';
    5 | import dayjs from 'dayjs';
    6 | import { toast } from '../lib/toast';
    7 | 
    8 | export async function exportFilteredMembersCsv(
    9 |   filter: MemberExportFilter,
   10 |   fallbackMembers?: Member[],
   11 |   branches?: Branch[]
   12 | ): Promise<number> {
   13 |   let memberList: Member[] = [];
   14 | 
   15 |   // Try fetching fresh data from backend
   16 |   try {
   17 |     const res = await fetch('/api/members');
   18 |     if (res.ok) {
   19 |       memberList = await res.json();
   20 |     } else if (fallbackMembers) {
   21 |       memberList = [...fallbackMembers];
   22 |     }
   23 |   } catch {
   24 |     if (fallbackMembers) {
   25 |       memberList = [...fallbackMembers];
   26 |     }
   27 |   }
   28 | 
   29 |   // Filter out archived members
   30 |   let filtered = memberList.filter((m) => !m.is_archived);
   31 | 
   32 |   // 1. Branch filter
   33 |   if (filter.branchId && filter.branchId !== 'all') {
   34 |     filtered = filtered.filter((m) => m.branch_id === filter.branchId);
   35 |   }
   36 | 
   37 |   // 2. Status filter
   38 |   if (filter.status && filter.status !== 'all') {
   39 |     filtered = filtered.filter((m) => m.status === filter.status);
   40 |   }
   41 | 
   42 |   // 3. Balance dues only
   43 |   if (filter.balanceOnly) {
   44 |     filtered = filtered.filter((m) => Number(m.balance_due || 0) > 0);
   45 |   }
   46 | 
   47 |   // 4. Expiring within days
   48 |   if (filter.expiringWithinDays && filter.expiringWithinDays > 0) {
   49 |     const todayStr = dayjs().format('YYYY-MM-DD');
   50 |     const toStr = dayjs().add(filter.expiringWithinDays, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-DD');
   51 |     filtered = filtered.filter((m) => {
   52 |       if (!m.end_date) return false;
   53 |       return m.end_date >= todayStr && m.end_date <= toStr;
   54 |     });
   55 |   }
   56 | 
   57 |   // 5. Search query
   58 |   if (filter.search?.trim()) {
   59 |     const q = filter.search.trim().toLowerCase();
   60 |     filtered = filtered.filter(
   61 |       (m) =>
   62 |         m.full_name?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
   63 |         m.phone?.includes(q) ||
   64 |         m.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
   65 |     );
   66 |   }
   67 | 
   68 |   // Map to CSV rows
   69 |   const branchMap: Record<string, string> = {};
   70 |   if (branches) {
   71 |     branches.forEach((b) => {
   72 |       branchMap[b.id] = b.name;
   73 |     });
   74 |   }
   75 | 
   76 |   const rows: MemberCsvRow[] = filtered.map((m) => ({
   77 |     full_name: m.full_name,
   78 |     phone: m.phone,
   79 |     email: m.email || null,
   80 |     gender: m.gender || null,
   81 |     status: m.status || null,
   82 |     end_date: m.end_date || null,
   83 |     balance_due: m.balance_due ?? 0,
   84 |     package_type: m.package_type || null,
   85 |     branch_name: m.branch_name || branchMap[m.branch_id] || (m.branch_id === 'br_nag_1' ? 'Pulse Fitness - Nagarabhavi' : m.branch_id === 'br_rr_2' ? 'Pulse Fitness - RR Nagar' : 'Pulse Fitness - Banashankari'),
   86 |   }));
   87 | 
   88 |   const csv = membersToCsv(rows);
   89 |   const stamp = dayjs().format('YYYYMMDD-HHmm');
   90 |   downloadCsv(`pulse-members-${stamp}.csv`, csv);
   91 | 
   92 |   // Post audit log to backend
   93 |   try {
   94 |     await fetch('/api/export-logs', {
   95 |       method: 'POST',
   96 |       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   97 |       body: JSON.stringify({
   98 |         export_type: 'members_csv',
   99 |         row_count: rows.length,
  100 |         branch_id: filter.branchId ?? null,
  101 |         meta: filter,
  102 |       }),
  103 |     });
  104 |   } catch (err) {
  105 |     console.warn('Failed to record export audit log', err);
  106 |   }
  107 | 
  108 |   return rows.length;
  109 | }
  110 | 
  111 | export function useExportMembersCsv(fallbackMembers?: Member[], branches?: Branch[]) {
  112 |   const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  113 | 
  114 |   const runExport = async (filter: MemberExportFilter = {}) => {
  115 |     setExporting(true);
  116 |     try {
  117 |       const count = await exportFilteredMembersCsv(filter, fallbackMembers, branches);
  118 |       toast.success(`Exported ${count} members to CSV`);
  119 |       return count;
  120 |     } catch (e: any) {
  121 |       toast.error(e?.message || 'Failed to export members CSV');
  122 |       throw e;
  123 |     } finally {
  124 |       setExporting(false);
  125 |     }
  126 |   };
  127 | 
  128 |   return { exporting, runExport };
  129 | }

FILE [53/107]: src/hooks/useOptimisticMutation.ts (83 lines)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    1 | import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
    2 | import { enqueueMutation } from '../lib/offline-queue';
    3 | 
    4 | export interface OptimisticMutationOptions<TVariables = any, TData = any> {
    5 |   mutationFn: (variables: TVariables) => Promise<TData>;
    6 |   queryKeys?: any[][];
    7 |   updateCache?: (variables: TVariables, oldState: any) => any;
    8 |   rollbackCache?: (variables: TVariables, oldState: any) => any;
    9 |   onSuccess?: (data: TData, variables: TVariables) => void;
   10 |   onError?: (error: Error, variables: TVariables, rollbackContext?: any) => void;
   11 |   successMessage?: string;
   12 |   errorMessage?: string;
   13 |   mutationType?: string;
   14 | }
   15 | 
   16 | export function useOptimisticMutation<TVariables = any, TData = any>(
   17 |   options: OptimisticMutationOptions<TVariables, TData>
   18 | ) {
   19 |   const [isPending, setIsPending] = useState<boolean>(false);
   20 |   const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
   21 | 
   22 |   const mutate = useCallback(
   23 |     async (variables: TVariables, currentCacheState?: any, setCacheState?: (updater: any) => void) => {
   24 |       setIsPending(true);
   25 |       setError(null);
   26 | 
   27 |       // 1. Snapshot previous state for rollback
   28 |       const snapshot = currentCacheState;
   29 | 
   30 |       // 2. Perform optimistic update immediately
   31 |       if (setCacheState && options.updateCache) {
   32 |         setCacheState((old: any) => options.updateCache!(variables, old));
   33 |       }
   34 | 
   35 |       try {
   36 |         // 3. Execute remote mutation
   37 |         const result = await options.mutationFn(variables);
   38 |         setIsPending(false);
   39 |         if (options.onSuccess) {
   40 |           options.onSuccess(result, variables);
   41 |         }
   42 |         return result;
   43 |       } catch (err: any) {
   44 |         const errorObj = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err));
   45 |         setError(errorObj);
   46 |         setIsPending(false);
   47 | 
   48 |         // 4. Automatic Rollback on failure!
   49 |         if (setCacheState) {
   50 |           if (options.rollbackCache) {
   51 |             setCacheState((current: any) => options.rollbackCache!(variables, current));
   52 |           } else if (snapshot !== undefined) {
   53 |             setCacheState(snapshot);
   54 |           }
   55 |         }
   56 | 
   57 |         // 5. Enqueue offline mutation if network failed
   58 |         if (!navigator.onLine || errorObj.message.toLowerCase().includes('network') || errorObj.message.toLowerCase().includes('fetch')) {
   59 |           await enqueueMutation({
   60 |             type: options.mutationType || 'generic_mutation',
   61 |             variables,
   62 |           });
   63 |         }
   64 | 
   65 |         if (options.onError) {
   66 |           options.onError(errorObj, variables, snapshot);
   67 |         }
   68 | 
   69 |         throw errorObj;
   70 |       }
   71 |     },
   72 |     [options]
   73 |   );
   74 | 
   75 |   return {
   76 |     mutate,
   77 |     mutateAsync: mutate,
   78 |     isPending,
   79 |     isLoading: isPending,
   80 |     error,
   81 |   };
   82 | }
   83 |

   43 | export function usePayrollReconciliation(month: string, branchId?: string | null) {
   44 |   const period = month
   45 |     ? dayjs(month.length === 7 ? `${month}-01` : month).startOf('month').format('YYYY-MM-DD')
   46 |     : dayjs().startOf('month').format('YYYY-MM-DD');
   47 | 
   48 |   const [rows, setRows] = useState<ReconciliationRow[]>([]);
   49 |   const [totals, setTotals] = useState({
   50 |     earned: 0,
   51 |     pending: 0,
   52 |     paid: 0,
   53 |     void: 0,
   54 |   });
   55 |   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
   56 |   const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
   57 | 
   58 |   const fetchReconciliation = useCallback(async () => {
   59 |     setIsLoading(true);
   60 |     setError(null);
   61 |     try {
   62 |       const params = new URLSearchParams();
   63 |       params.set('period_month', period);
   64 |       if (branchId && branchId !== 'all') {
   65 |         params.set('branch_id', branchId);
   66 |       }
   67 | 
   68 |       const data = await safeFetchJson<{ period_month: string; rows: ReconciliationRow[] }>(
   69 |         `/api/payroll-reconciliation?${params.toString()}`,
   70 |         undefined,
   71 |         null
   72 |       );
   73 |       const fetchedRows: ReconciliationRow[] = data?.rows || [];
   74 | 
   75 |       // Calculate variance per row
   76 |       const enhancedRows = fetchedRows.map((r) => {
   77 |         const earned = Number(r.earned_amount || 0);
   78 |         const pending = Number(r.pending_amount || 0);
   79 |         const paid = Number(r.paid_amount || 0);
   80 |         const variance = Math.round((earned - (pending + paid)) * 100) / 100;
   81 |         return {
   82 |           ...r,
   83 |           variance,
   84 |         };
   85 |       });
   86 | 
   87 |       setRows(enhancedRows);
   88 |       setTotals({
   89 |         earned: enhancedRows.reduce((s, r) => s + Number(r.earned_amount || 0), 0),
   90 |         pending: enhancedRows.reduce((s, r) => s + Number(r.pending_amount || 0), 0),
   91 |         paid: enhancedRows.reduce((s, r) => s + Number(r.paid_amount || 0), 0),
   92 |         void: enhancedRows.reduce((s, r) => s + Number(r.void_amount || 0), 0),
   93 |       });
   94 |     } catch (err: any) {
   95 |       console.error('Payroll reconciliation error:', err);
   96 |       setError(err);
   97 |     } finally {
   98 |       setIsLoading(false);
   99 |     }
  100 |   }, [period, branchId]);
  101 | 
  102 |   useEffect(() => {
  103 |     fetchReconciliation();
  104 |   }, [fetchReconciliation]);
  105 | 
  106 |   return {
  107 |     period,
  108 |     rows,
  109 |     totals,
  110 |     isLoading,
  111 |     error,
  112 |     refetch: fetchReconciliation,
  113 |   };
  114 | }

  133 |

  152 | 
  153 |   return {
  154 |     lines,
  155 |     isLoading,
  156 |     error,
  157 |     refetch: fetchLines,
  158 |   };
  159 | }
  160 | 
  161 | export function buildPayrollReconciliationCsv(rows: ReconciliationRow[], period: string): string {
  162 |   const header = [
  163 |     'Period Month',
  164 |     'Branch',
  165 |     'Trainer Name',
  166 |     'Earned Amount (₹)',
  167 |     'Pending Amount (₹)',
  168 |     'Paid Amount (₹)',
  169 |     'Void Amount (₹)',
  170 |     'Pending Lines',
  171 |     'Paid Lines',
  172 |     'Void Lines',
  173 |     'Reconciliation Variance (₹)',
  174 |   ];
  175 | 
  176 |   const lines = [header.join(',')];
  177 | 
  178 |   for (const r of rows) {
  179 |     const vals = [
  180 |       period,
  181 |       r.branch_name || 'All Branches',
  182 |       r.trainer_name || 'Trainer',
  183 |       r.earned_amount,
  184 |       r.pending_amount,
  185 |       r.paid_amount,
  186 |       r.void_amount,
  187 |       r.pending_lines,
  188 |       r.paid_lines,
  189 |       r.void_lines,
  190 |       r.variance ?? 0,
  191 |     ].map((v) => `"${String(v ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`);
  192 | 
  193 |     lines.push(vals.join(','));
  194 |   }
  195 | 
  196 |   return lines.join('\n');
  197 | }

    1 | import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
    2 | import { StaffNotification } from '../types';

    4 | 
    5 | export function useStaffNotifications(userId?: string, branchId?: string) {
    6 |   const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<StaffNotification[]>([]);
    7 |   const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState<number>(0);
    8 |   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
    9 | 
   10 |   const fetchNotifications = useCallback(async () => {
   11 |     if (!userId) return;
   12 |     try {
   13 |       const data = await safeFetchJson<StaffNotification[]>(
   14 |         `/api/notifications?user_id=${userId}&branch_id=${branchId || 'all'}`,
   15 |         undefined,
   16 |         null
   17 |       );
   18 |       if (data) {
   19 |         setNotifications(data);
   20 |         setUnreadCount(data.filter((n) => !n.is_read).length);
   21 |       }
   22 |     } catch (err) {
   23 |       console.error('Failed to fetch staff notifications:', err);
   24 |     } finally {
   25 |       setIsLoading(false);
   26 |     }
   27 |   }, [userId, branchId]);
   28 | 
   29 |   useEffect(() => {
   30 |     fetchNotifications();
   31 |     const interval = setInterval(fetchNotifications, 4000);
   32 |     return () => clearInterval(interval);
   33 |   }, [fetchNotifications]);
   34 | 
   35 |   const markAsRead = async (notificationId: string) => {
   36 |     try {
   37 |       const res = await fetch(`/api/notifications/${notificationId}/read`, { method: 'POST' });
   38 |       if (res.ok) {
   39 |         setNotifications((prev) =>
   40 |           prev.map((n) => (n.id === notificationId ? { ...n, is_read: true } : n))
   41 |         );
   42 |         setUnreadCount((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
   43 |       }
   44 |     } catch (err) {
   45 |       console.error('Failed to mark notification as read:', err);
   46 |     }
   47 |   };
   48 | 
   49 |   const markAllAsRead = async () => {
   50 |     if (!userId) return;
   51 |     try {
   52 |       const res = await fetch(`/api/notifications/read-all`, {
   53 |         method: 'POST',
   54 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   55 |         body: JSON.stringify({ user_id: userId }),
   56 |       });
   57 |       if (res.ok) {
   58 |         setNotifications((prev) => prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, is_read: true })));
   59 |         setUnreadCount(0);
   60 |       }
   61 |     } catch (err) {
   62 |       console.error('Failed to mark all notifications as read:', err);
   63 |     }
   64 |   };
   65 | 
   66 |   return {
   67 |     notifications,
   68 |     unreadCount,
   69 |     isLoading,
   70 |     refetch: fetchNotifications,
   71 |     markAsRead,
   72 |     markAllAsRead,
   73 |   };
   74 | }

FILE [61/107]: src/hooks/useTrainerPerformance.ts (121 lines)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    1 | import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    2 | import dayjs from 'dayjs';
    3 | import { Profile, Member, CommissionSettlement } from '../types';
    4 | import { safeFetchJson } from '../lib/apiUtils';
    5 | 
    6 | export type TrainerPerformanceItem = {
    7 |   trainerId: string;
    8 |   name: string;
    9 |   role: string;
   10 |   branchName?: string;
   11 |   activationsMtd: number;
   12 |   activeMembers: number;
   13 |   totalMembers: number;
   14 |   retentionRate: number;
   15 |   commissionEarnedMtd: number;
   16 |   pendingCommission: number;
   17 | };
   18 | 
   19 | export function useTrainerPerformance(branchId?: string | null) {
   20 |   const [data, setData] = useState<TrainerPerformanceItem[]>([]);
   21 |   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
   22 |   const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
   23 | 
   24 |   const fetchData = async () => {
   25 |     setIsLoading(true);
   26 |     setError(null);
   27 |     try {
   28 |       const [trainers, members, settlements, branches] = await Promise.all([
   29 |         safeFetchJson<Profile[]>('/api/trainers', undefined, []),
   30 |         safeFetchJson<Member[]>('/api/members', undefined, []),
   31 |         safeFetchJson<CommissionSettlement[]>('/api/commission-settlements', undefined, []),
   32 |         safeFetchJson<any[]>('/api/branches', undefined, []),
   33 |       ]);
   34 | 
   35 |       let trainerList = trainers || [];
   36 |       if (trainerList.length === 0) {
   37 |         const allProfs = await safeFetchJson<Profile[]>('/api/profiles', undefined, []);
   38 |         trainerList = (allProfs || []).filter((p) => p.role === 'trainer');
   39 |       }
   40 | 
   41 |       const branchList = branches || [];
   42 |       const memberList = members || [];
   43 |       const settlementList = settlements || [];
   44 | 
   45 |       const filteredTrainers = trainerList.filter((t) => {
   46 |         if (branchId && branchId !== 'all' && t.branch_id && t.branch_id !== branchId) return false;
   47 |         return true;
   48 |       });
   49 | 
   50 |       const today = dayjs().format('YYYY-MM-DD');
   51 | 
   52 |       const items: TrainerPerformanceItem[] = filteredTrainers.map((t) => {
   53 |         const mine = memberList.filter((m) => !m.is_archived && m.onboarded_by === t.id);
   54 |         
   55 |         // Activations MTD (start_date in this current calendar month)
   56 |         const activationsMtd = mine.filter((m) => {
   57 |           if (!m.start_date) return false;
   58 |           return dayjs(m.start_date).isSame(dayjs(), 'month');
   59 |         }).length;
   60 | 
   61 |         // Active members in trainer's client book
   62 |         const active = mine.filter((m) => m.status === 'active').length;
   63 |         const total = mine.length || 1;
   64 | 
   65 |         // Retained: active and membership end_date >= today
   66 |         const retained = mine.filter(
   67 |           (m) => m.status === 'active' && m.end_date && m.end_date >= today
   68 |         ).length;
   69 | 
   70 |         const retentionRate = Math.round((retained / total) * 100);
   71 | 
   72 |         // Calculate commissions
   73 |         const earnedFromMembers = mine.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m.commission_amount || 0), 0);
   74 |         const settledForTrainer = settlements
   75 |           .filter((s) => s.trainer_id === t.id && s.status === 'paid')
   76 |           .reduce((sum, s) => sum + (s.total_commission || 0), 0);
   77 | 
   78 |         const pending = Math.max(0, earnedFromMembers - settledForTrainer);
   79 | 
   80 |         const matchedBranch = branchList.find((b) => b.id === t.branch_id);
   81 |         const branchName = t.branch_name || (matchedBranch ? matchedBranch.name : 'Pulse Fitness - Nagarabhavi');
   82 | 
   83 |         return {
   84 |           trainerId: t.id,
   85 |           name: t.full_name || 'Trainer',
   86 |           role: t.role,
   87 |           branchName,
   88 |           activationsMtd,
   89 |           activeMembers: active,
   90 |           totalMembers: mine.length,
   91 |           retentionRate,
   92 |           commissionEarnedMtd: earnedFromMembers,
   93 |           pendingCommission: pending,
   94 |         };
   95 |       });
   96 | 
   97 |       // Sort by activations MTD desc
   98 |       items.sort((a, b) => b.activationsMtd - a.activationsMtd);
   99 |       setData(items);
  100 |     } catch (err: any) {
  101 |       console.error('Failed to load trainer performance:', err);
  102 |       setError(err);
  103 |     } finally {
  104 |       setIsLoading(false);
  105 |     }
  106 |   };
  107 | 
  108 |   useEffect(() => {
  109 |     fetchData();
  110 |     const interval = setInterval(fetchData, 8000);
  111 |     return () => clearInterval(interval);
  112 |   }, [branchId]);
  113 | 
  114 |   return {
  115 |     data,
  116 |     isLoading,
  117 |     error,
  118 |     refetch: fetchData,
  119 |   };
  120 | }
  121 |

    1 | import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
    2 | import { WinbackCampaign, WinbackEnrollment, WinbackAttempt, Member } from '../types';
    3 | import { toast } from '../lib/toast';
    4 | import { safeFetchJson } from '../lib/apiUtils';
    5 | 
    6 | export interface HydratedEnrollment extends WinbackEnrollment {
    7 |   member?: Member;
    8 |   prediction?: any;
    9 | }
   10 | 
   11 | export interface CampaignRunReport {
   12 |   success: boolean;
   13 |   campaign_id: string;
   14 |   campaign_name: string;
   15 |   examined_active: number;
   16 |   enrolled_new: number;
   17 |   sent: number;
   18 |   skipped_silence_hours: number;
   19 |   suppressed: number;
   20 |   exhausted: number;
   21 |   is_silence_hours: boolean;
   22 |   errors: string[];
   23 |   executed_at: string;
   24 | }
   25 | 
   26 | export function useWinbackCampaigns(branchId?: string, statusFilter?: string, searchQuery?: string) {
   27 |   const [campaigns, setCampaigns] = useState<WinbackCampaign[]>([]);
   28 |   const [enrollments, setEnrollments] = useState<HydratedEnrollment[]>([]);
   29 |   const [attempts, setAttempts] = useState<WinbackAttempt[]>([]);
   30 |   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
   31 |   const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState<boolean>(false);
   32 |   const [isEnrolling, setIsEnrolling] = useState<boolean>(false);
   33 |   const [lastReport, setLastReport] = useState<CampaignRunReport | null>(null);
   34 | 
   35 |   const fetchCampaigns = useCallback(async () => {
   36 |     try {
   37 |       const data = await safeFetchJson<WinbackCampaign[]>('/api/winback/campaigns', undefined, []);
   38 |       setCampaigns(data || []);
   39 |     } catch (err) {
   40 |       console.error(err);
   41 |     }
   42 |   }, []);
   43 | 
   44 |   const fetchEnrollments = useCallback(async () => {
   45 |     try {
   46 |       const params = new URLSearchParams();
   47 |       if (branchId && branchId !== 'all') params.append('branch_id', branchId);
   48 |       if (statusFilter && statusFilter !== 'all') params.append('status', statusFilter);
   49 |       if (searchQuery) params.append('search', searchQuery);
   50 | 
   51 |       const data = await safeFetchJson<HydratedEnrollment[]>(
   52 |         `/api/winback/enrollments?${params.toString()}`,
   53 |         undefined,
   54 |         []
   55 |       );
   56 |       setEnrollments(data || []);
   57 |     } catch (err) {
   58 |       console.error(err);
   59 |     }
   60 |   }, [branchId, statusFilter, searchQuery]);
   61 | 
   62 |   const fetchAttempts = useCallback(async () => {
   63 |     try {
   64 |       const data = await safeFetchJson<WinbackAttempt[]>('/api/winback/attempts', undefined, []);
   65 |       setAttempts(data || []);
   66 |     } catch (err) {
   67 |       console.error(err);
   68 |     }
   69 |   }, []);
   70 | 
   71 |   const fetchAll = useCallback(async () => {
   72 |     setIsLoading(true);
   73 |     await Promise.all([fetchCampaigns(), fetchEnrollments(), fetchAttempts()]);
   74 |     setIsLoading(false);
   75 |   }, [fetchCampaigns, fetchEnrollments, fetchAttempts]);
   76 | 
   77 |   useEffect(() => {
   78 |     fetchAll();
   79 |     const interval = setInterval(() => {
   80 |       fetchEnrollments();
   81 |       fetchAttempts();
   82 |     }, 8000);
   83 |     return () => clearInterval(interval);
   84 |   }, [fetchAll, fetchEnrollments, fetchAttempts]);
   85 | 
   86 |   const runCampaign = async (options?: { campaignId?: string; forceBypassSilence?: boolean }): Promise<CampaignRunReport> => {
   87 |     setIsRunning(true);
   88 |     try {
   89 |       const res = await fetch('/api/winback/run', {
   90 |         method: 'POST',
   91 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   92 |         body: JSON.stringify({
   93 |           campaign_id: options?.campaignId,
   94 |           force_bypass_silence: options?.forceBypassSilence,
   95 |         }),
   96 |       });
   97 | 
   98 |       if (!res.ok) {
   99 |         const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'Run failed' }));
  100 |         throw new Error(err.error || 'Campaign execution failed');
  101 |       }
  102 | 
  103 |       const report: CampaignRunReport = await res.json();
  104 |       setLastReport(report);
  105 |       await Promise.all([fetchEnrollments(), fetchAttempts()]);
  106 | 
  107 |       if (report.sent > 0) {
  108 |         toast.success(`🎯 Win-Back Dispatched: ${report.sent} touches sent (${report.enrolled_new} newly enrolled)`);
  109 |       } else if (report.skipped_silence_hours > 0) {
  110 |         toast.warning(`🌙 Silence Hours Active (IST 21:00-08:00): ${report.skipped_silence_hours} WhatsApp/SMS buffered.`, {
  111 |           duration: 6000,
  112 |         });
  113 |       } else {
  114 |         toast.info(`Win-back evaluation complete: ${report.examined_active} examined, 0 sent (cooldown or converted).`);
  115 |       }
  116 | 
  117 |       return report;
  118 |     } catch (err: any) {
  119 |       toast.error(err.message || 'Campaign dispatch failed');
  120 |       throw err;
  121 |     } finally {
  122 |       setIsRunning(false);
  123 |     }
  124 |   };
  125 | 
  126 |   const enrollMember = async ({ memberId, campaignId }: { memberId: string; campaignId?: string }) => {
  127 |     setIsEnrolling(true);
  128 |     try {
  129 |       const res = await fetch('/api/winback/enroll', {
  130 |         method: 'POST',
  131 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  132 |         body: JSON.stringify({ member_id: memberId, campaign_id: campaignId }),
  133 |       });
  134 |       if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to enroll member');
  135 |       await fetchEnrollments();
  136 |       toast.success('Member enrolled in win-back campaign');
  137 |     } catch (err: any) {
  138 |       toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to enroll member');
  139 |     } finally {
  140 |       setIsEnrolling(false);
  141 |     }
  142 |   };
  143 | 
  144 |   return {
  145 |     campaigns,
  146 |     enrollments,
  147 |     attempts,
  148 |     isLoading,
  149 |     isRunning,
  150 |     lastReport,
  151 |     isEnrolling,
  152 |     runCampaign,
  153 |     enrollMember,
  154 |     refetch: fetchAll,
  155 |   };
  156 | }

   13 |   trainer,
   14 |   pendingCommissionAmount,
   15 |   onClose,
   16 |   onSettlementSuccess
   17 | }) => {
   18 |   const [settlementAmount, setSettlementAmount] = useState<string>(pendingCommissionAmount.toString());
   19 |   const [notes, setNotes] = useState<string>('Commission payout settled via GPay / Cash');
   20 |   const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
   21 |   const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
   22 | 
   23 |   const handleSettle = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
   24 |     e.preventDefault();
   25 |     setIsSubmitting(true);
   26 |     setErrorMessage(null);
   27 | 
   28 |     try {
   29 |       const amt = parseFloat(settlementAmount);
   30 |       if (isNaN(amt) || amt <= 0) {
   31 |         throw new Error('Please enter a valid positive settlement amount');
   32 |       }
   33 | 
   34 |       const res = await fetch('/api/commission-settlements', {
   35 |         method: 'POST',
   36 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   37 |         body: JSON.stringify({
   38 |           trainer_id: trainer.id,
   39 |           total_commission: amt,
   40 |           notes: notes || undefined
   41 |         })
   42 |       });
   43 | 
   44 |       if (!res.ok) {
   45 |         const err = await res.json();
   46 |         throw new Error(err.error || 'Failed to record commission settlement');
   47 |       }
   48 | 
   49 |       onSettlementSuccess();
   50 |       onClose();
   51 |     } catch (err: any) {
   52 |       setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Settlement failed');
   53 |     } finally {
   54 |       setIsSubmitting(false);
   55 |     }
   56 |   };
   57 | 
   58 |   return (
   59 |     <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">

   10 | 
   11 |   const phase2SqlSchema = `-- Pulse Fitness Gym - Phase 2 Supabase Migration SQL & RLS Policies
   12 | 
   13 | -- 1. Extend Members Table
   14 | ALTER TABLE members 
   15 |   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS amount_paid NUMERIC(10,2),
   16 |   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS balance_due NUMERIC(10,2) DEFAULT 0,
   17 |   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS payment_reference TEXT,
