   21 |   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS archived_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
   22 |   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS archived_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id);
   23 | 
   24 | -- 2. Create Attendance Table
   25 | CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance (
   26 |   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
   27 |   member_id UUID REFERENCES members(id) NOT NULL,
   28 |   checked_in_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
   29 |   checked_in_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id),
   30 |   method TEXT CHECK (method IN ('qr', 'manual', 'biometric')) DEFAULT 'qr',
   31 |   notes TEXT
   32 | );
   33 | 
   34 | -- 3. Create Export Logs Table
   35 | CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS export_logs (
   36 |   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
   37 |   exported_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id),
   38 |   export_type TEXT CHECK (export_type IN ('vcf', 'csv', 'clipboard')),
   39 |   filter_used TEXT,
   40 |   member_count INTEGER,
   41 |   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
   42 | );
   43 | 
   44 | -- 4. Create Commission Settlements Table
   45 | CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS commission_settlements (
   46 |   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
   47 |   trainer_id UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) NOT NULL,
   48 |   period_start DATE,
   49 |   period_end DATE,
   50 |   total_commission NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
   51 |   status TEXT CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid')) DEFAULT 'pending',
   52 |   paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
   53 |   notes TEXT,
   54 |   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
   55 | );
   56 | 
   57 | -- 5. Enable Row Level Security (RLS)
   58 | ALTER TABLE attendance ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
   59 | ALTER TABLE export_logs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
   60 | ALTER TABLE commission_settlements ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
   61 | 
   62 | -- 6. RLS Policies for Attendance
   63 | CREATE POLICY "Owners full access on attendance" 
   64 |   ON attendance FOR ALL 
   65 |   USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'owner'));
   66 | 
   67 | CREATE POLICY "Trainers view own created attendance" 
   68 |   ON attendance FOR SELECT 
   69 |   USING (checked_in_by = auth.uid());
   70 | 
   71 | CREATE POLICY "Trainers insert attendance" 
   72 |   ON attendance FOR INSERT 
   73 |   WITH CHECK (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL);
   74 | 
   75 | -- 7. RLS Policies for Commission Settlements
   76 | CREATE POLICY "Owners full access on settlements" 
   77 |   ON commission_settlements FOR ALL

   72 |

    1 | import React, { useState } from 'react';
    2 | import { Profile } from '../../types';
    3 | import { LoadingButton } from '../ui/LoadingButton';
    4 | import { CheckSquare, UserCheck, Shield, X, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
    5 | import { toast } from '../../lib/toast';
    6 | 
    7 | interface BulkMemberActionsProps {
    8 |   selectedIds: string[];
    9 |   trainers: Profile[];
   10 |   onClearSelection: () => void;
   11 |   onSuccess: () => void;
   12 | }
   13 | 
   14 | export const BulkMemberActions: React.FC<BulkMemberActionsProps> = ({
   15 |   selectedIds,
   16 |   trainers,
   17 |   onClearSelection,
   18 |   onSuccess,
   19 | }) => {
   20 |   const [selectedStatus, setSelectedStatus] = useState<string>('');
   21 |   const [selectedTrainerId, setSelectedTrainerId] = useState<string>('');
   22 |   const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);
   23 | 
   24 |   if (selectedIds.length === 0) return null;
   25 | 
   26 |   const handleApply = async () => {
   27 |     if (!selectedStatus && !selectedTrainerId) {
   28 |       toast.error('Select a status or trainer to apply to selected members.');
   29 |       return;
   30 |     }
   31 | 
   32 |     setIsSubmitting(true);
   33 |     try {
   34 |       const res = await fetch('/api/members/bulk-update', {
   35 |         method: 'POST',
   36 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
   37 |         body: JSON.stringify({
   38 |           member_ids: selectedIds,
   39 |           status: selectedStatus || undefined,
   40 |           trainer_id: selectedTrainerId || undefined,
   41 |         }),
   42 |       });
   43 | 
   44 |       const resData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
   45 | 
   46 |       if (!res.ok) {
   47 |         throw new Error(resData.error || 'Failed to update members in bulk');
   48 |       }
   49 | 
   50 |       toast.success(`Successfully updated ${resData.updated_count || selectedIds.length} members`);
   51 |       onClearSelection();
   52 |       onSuccess();
   53 |     } catch (err: any) {
   54 |       console.error('Bulk update error:', err);
   55 |       toast.error(err.message || 'Bulk operation failed');
   56 |     } finally {
   57 |       setIsSubmitting(false);
   58 |     }
   59 |   };
   60 | 
   61 |   return (
   62 |     <div className="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40 max-w-2xl w-[92%] sm:w-full bg-zinc-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-zinc-700 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-2xl animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
   63 |       {/* Selection Count */}
   64 |       <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5 text-white shrink-0">
   65 |         <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-red-600/20 border border-red-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-red-400">
   66 |           <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
   67 |         </div>
   68 |         <div>
   69 |           <div className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider">
   70 |             {selectedIds.length} Members Selected
   71 |           </div>
   72 |           <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">Batch operations</p>
   73 |         </div>
   74 |       </div>
   75 | 
   76 |       {/* Select Controls */}
   77 |       <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end">
   78 |         {/* Status Picker */}
   79 |         <select
   80 |           value={selectedStatus}
   81 |           onChange={(e) => setSelectedStatus(e.target.value)}
   82 |           className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-white rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-red-500"
   83 |         >
   84 |           <option value="">Status (No Change)</option>
   85 |           <option value="active">Active</option>
   86 |           <option value="pending">Pending</option>
   87 |           <option value="expired">Expired</option>

  371 |                     </tr>

  374 |               </tbody>
  375 |             </table>
  376 |           </div>

  378 |       </div>

    1 | import React from 'react';

    4 | 
    5 | export type DateRange = {
    6 |   from: string; // YYYY-MM-DD
    7 |   to: string;   // YYYY-MM-DD
    8 | };
    9 | 
   10 | interface DateRangePickerProps {
   11 |   value: DateRange;
   12 |   onChange: (next: DateRange) => void;
   13 |   maxDays?: number;
   14 |   className?: string;
   15 | }
   16 | 
   17 | export const DateRangePicker: React.FC<DateRangePickerProps> = ({
   18 |   value,
   19 |   onChange,
   20 |   maxDays = 93,
   21 |   className = '',
   22 | }) => {
   23 |   const setPreset = (days: number) => {
   24 |     onChange({
   25 |       from: dayjs().subtract(days - 1, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
   26 |       to: dayjs().format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
   27 |     });
   28 |   };
   29 | 
   30 |   const diffDays = dayjs(value.to).diff(dayjs(value.from), 'day');
   31 | 
   32 |   return (
   33 |     <div className={`flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-3 ${className}`}>
   34 |       {/* Preset Pills */}

   36 |         <button
   37 |           type="button"
   38 |           onClick={() => setPreset(1)}
   39 |           className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
   40 |             diffDays === 0
   41 |               ? 'bg-red-600 text-white shadow'
   42 |               : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
   43 |           }`}
   44 |         >
   45 |           Today
   46 |         </button>
   47 |         <button
   48 |           type="button"
   49 |           onClick={() => setPreset(7)}
   50 |           className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
   51 |             diffDays === 6
   52 |               ? 'bg-red-600 text-white shadow'
   53 |               : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
   54 |           }`}
   55 |         >
   56 |           7d
   57 |         </button>
   58 |         <button
   59 |           type="button"
   60 |           onClick={() => setPreset(14)}
   61 |           className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
   62 |             diffDays === 13
   63 |               ? 'bg-red-600 text-white shadow'
   64 |               : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
   65 |           }`}
   66 |         >
   67 |           14d
   68 |         </button>
   69 |         <button

  102 | -- ============================================================
  103 | -- 2) Automated Churn Prediction Model
  104 | -- ============================================================
  105 | 
  106 | CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS member_churn_predictions (
  107 |   member_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  108 |   branch_id uuid REFERENCES branches(id),
  109 |   churn_probability numeric(5,4) NOT NULL CHECK (churn_probability >= 0 AND churn_probability <= 1),
  110 |   risk_band text NOT NULL CHECK (risk_band IN ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical')),
  111 |   factors jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  112 |   model_version text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'rules_v1',
  113 |   predicted_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  114 | );
  115 | 
  116 | CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_churn_pred_branch_band
  117 |   ON member_churn_predictions (branch_id, risk_band, churn_probability DESC);
  118 | 
  119 | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compute_churn_probability(p_member_id uuid)
  120 | RETURNS jsonb
  121 | LANGUAGE plpgsql
  122 | STABLE
  123 | SECURITY DEFINER
  124 | SET search_path = public
  125 | AS $$
  126 | DECLARE
  127 |   m record;
  128 |   last_visit timestamptz;
  129 |   days_since int;
  130 |   days_left int;
  131 |   visits_14 int;
  132 |   visits_prev_14 int;
  133 |   logit numeric := -2.2; -- base prior ~10% 
  134 |   prob numeric;
  135 |   factors jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  136 |   band text;
  137 | BEGIN
  138 |   SELECT id, branch_id, status, end_date, balance_due, start_date, is_archived
  139 |   INTO m FROM members WHERE id = p_member_id;
  140 | 
  141 |   IF NOT FOUND OR COALESCE(m.is_archived, false) OR m.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active' THEN
  142 |     RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  143 |       'probability', 0,
  144 |       'band', 'low',
  145 |       'factors', '[]'::jsonb
  146 |     );
  147 |   END IF;
  148 | 
  149 |   SELECT MAX(checked_in_at) INTO last_visit
  150 |   FROM attendance WHERE member_id = p_member_id;
  151 | 
  152 |   days_since := CASE
  153 |     WHEN last_visit IS NULL THEN 999
  154 |     ELSE (CURRENT_DATE - last_visit::date)
  155 |   END;
  156 | 
  157 |   days_left := CASE
  158 |     WHEN m.end_date IS NULL THEN 999
  159 |     ELSE (m.end_date - CURRENT_DATE)
  160 |   END;
  161 | 
  162 |   SELECT COUNT(*) INTO visits_14 FROM attendance
  163 |   WHERE member_id = p_member_id
  164 |     AND checked_in_at >= now() - interval '14 days';
  165 | 
  166 |   SELECT COUNT(*) INTO visits_prev_14 FROM attendance
  167 |   WHERE member_id = p_member_id
  168 |     AND checked_in_at >= now() - interval '28 days'
  169 |     AND checked_in_at < now() - interval '14 days';
  170 | 
  171 |   -- Feature contributions (log-odds style weights)
  172 |   IF last_visit IS NULL THEN
  173 |     logit := logit + 1.40;
  174 |     factors := factors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','never_visited','weight',1.40));
  175 |   ELSIF days_since >= 30 THEN
  176 |     logit := logit + 1.50;
  177 |     factors := factors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','stale_30d','weight',1.50,'days',days_since));
  178 |   ELSIF days_since >= 21 THEN
  179 |     logit := logit + 1.10;
  180 |     factors := factors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','stale_21d','weight',1.10,'days',days_since));
  181 |   ELSIF days_since >= 14 THEN
  182 |     logit := logit + 0.80;
  183 |     factors := factors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','stale_14d','weight',0.80,'days',days_since));
  184 |   END IF;
  185 | 
  186 |   IF visits_prev_14 >= 2 AND visits_14::numeric / visits_prev_14::numeric <= 0.5 THEN
  187 |     logit := logit + 0.90;
  188 |     factors := factors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','attendance_drop','weight',0.90));
  189 |   END IF;
  190 | 
  191 |   IF days_left <= 0 THEN
  192 |     logit := logit + 1.60;
  193 |     factors := factors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','expired','weight',1.60));
  194 |   ELSIF days_left <= 3 THEN
  195 |     logit := logit + 1.20;
  196 |     factors := factors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','expiring_3d','weight',1.20,'days_left',days_left));
  197 |   ELSIF days_left <= 7 THEN
  198 |     logit := logit + 0.85;
  199 |     factors := factors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','expiring_7d','weight',0.85,'days_left',days_left));
  200 |   END IF;
  201 | 
  202 |   IF COALESCE(m.balance_due, 0) > 0 THEN
  203 |     logit := logit + CASE
  204 |       WHEN m.balance_due >= 3000 THEN 0.70
  205 |       WHEN m.balance_due >= 1000 THEN 0.45
  206 |       ELSE 0.25
  207 |     END;
  208 |     factors := factors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','dues','weight',0.45,'amount',m.balance_due));
  209 |   END IF;
  210 | 
  211 |   -- sigmoid
  212 |   prob := 1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-logit));
  213 |   prob := ROUND(prob::numeric, 4);
  214 | 
  215 |   band := CASE
  216 |     WHEN prob >= 0.75 THEN 'critical'
  217 |     WHEN prob >= 0.55 THEN 'high'
  218 |     WHEN prob >= 0.30 THEN 'medium'
  219 |     ELSE 'low'
  220 |   END;
  221 | 
  222 |   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  223 |     'probability', prob,
  224 |     'band', band,
  225 |     'factors', factors,
  226 |     'branch_id', m.branch_id
  227 |   );
  228 | END;
  229 | $$;
  230 | 
  231 | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_churn_predictions()
  232 | RETURNS jsonb
  233 | LANGUAGE plpgsql
  234 | SECURITY DEFINER
  235 | SET search_path = public
  236 | AS $$
  237 | DECLARE
  238 |   r record;
  239 |   pred jsonb;
  240 |   n int := 0;
  241 | BEGIN
  242 |   FOR r IN
  243 |     SELECT id FROM members
  244 |     WHERE status = 'active' AND COALESCE(is_archived, false) = false
  245 |   LOOP
  246 |     pred := public.compute_churn_probability(r.id);
  247 |     INSERT INTO member_churn_predictions (
  248 |       member_id, branch_id, churn_probability, risk_band, factors, model_version, predicted_at
  249 |     )
  250 |     VALUES (
  251 |       r.id,
  252 |       (pred->>'branch_id')::uuid,
  253 |       (pred->>'probability')::numeric,
  254 |       pred->>'band',
  255 |       COALESCE(pred->'factors', '[]'::jsonb),
  256 |       'rules_v1',
  257 |       now()
  258 |     )
  259 |     ON CONFLICT (member_id) DO UPDATE SET
  260 |       branch_id = EXCLUDED.branch_id,
  261 |       churn_probability = EXCLUDED.churn_probability,
  262 |       risk_band = EXCLUDED.risk_band,
  263 |       factors = EXCLUDED.factors,
  264 |       model_version = EXCLUDED.model_version,
  265 |       predicted_at = now();
  266 |     n := n + 1;
  267 |   END LOOP;
  268 | 
  269 |   RETURN jsonb_build_object('updated', n, 'at', now());
  270 | END;
  271 | $$;
  272 | 
  273 | REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.refresh_churn_predictions FROM PUBLIC;
  274 | GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.refresh_churn_predictions TO service_role;

    1 | -- ============================================================================
    2 | -- FREEZE MEMBERSHIP HARDENING: ANNUAL (12-MONTH) ONLY & MAX 1 MONTH (30 DAYS)
    3 | -- ============================================================================
    4 | 
    5 | BEGIN;
    6 | 
    7 | -- 1. Helper RPC for UI phone-blur eligibility checks
    8 | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.member_freeze_eligible(
    9 |   p_phone TEXT,
   10 |   p_branch_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
   11 | )
   12 | RETURNS JSONB
   13 | LANGUAGE plpgsql
   14 | SECURITY DEFINER
   15 | SET search_path = public
   16 | AS $$
   17 | DECLARE
   18 |   phone10 TEXT;
   19 |   today DATE := (timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()))::date;
   20 |   m RECORD;
   21 |   is_annual BOOLEAN;
   22 |   projected_end DATE;
   23 | BEGIN
   24 |   phone10 := right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(p_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 10);
   25 |   IF length(phone10) <> 10 THEN
   26 |     RETURN jsonb_build_object('eligible', false, 'reason', 'INVALID_PHONE');
   27 |   END IF;
   28 | 
   29 |   SELECT id, full_name, end_date, subscription_months, lower(COALESCE(package_type, '')) AS pkg, status
   30 |   INTO m
   31 |   FROM public.members
   32 |   WHERE right(regexp_replace(COALESCE(phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 10) = phone10
   33 |     AND COALESCE(is_archived, false) = false
   34 |     AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR branch_id = p_branch_id)
   35 |   ORDER BY created_at DESC
   36 |   LIMIT 1;
   37 | 
   38 |   IF m.id IS NULL THEN
   39 |     RETURN jsonb_build_object('eligible', false, 'reason', 'MEMBER_NOT_FOUND');
   40 |   END IF;
   41 | 
   42 |   IF m.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active' THEN
   43 |     RETURN jsonb_build_object('eligible', false, 'reason', 'NOT_ACTIVE', 'member_id', m.id);
   44 |   END IF;
   45 | 
   46 |   IF m.end_date IS NULL OR m.end_date < today THEN
   47 |     RETURN jsonb_build_object('eligible', false, 'reason', 'EXPIRED', 'member_id', m.id, 'end_date', m.end_date);
   48 |   END IF;
   49 | 
   50 |   is_annual := (COALESCE(m.subscription_months, 0) = 12 OR m.pkg LIKE '%annual%' OR m.pkg LIKE '%year%');
   51 |   IF NOT is_annual THEN
   52 |     RETURN jsonb_build_object(
   53 |       'eligible', false,
   54 |       'reason', 'NOT_ANNUAL',
   55 |       'member_id', m.id,
   56 |       'full_name', m.full_name,
   57 |       'subscription_months', m.subscription_months
   58 |     );
   59 |   END IF;
   60 | 
   61 |   projected_end := (m.end_date + '30 days'::interval)::date;
   62 | 
   63 |   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
   64 |     'eligible', true,
   65 |     'member_id', m.id,
   66 |     'full_name', m.full_name,
   67 |     'current_end_date', m.end_date,
   68 |     'projected_end_date', projected_end,
   69 |     'freeze_days', 30
   70 |   );
   71 | END;
   72 | $$;

   54 |   )

   87 | -- RPC: staff_check_in
   88 | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_check_in(
   89 |   p_staff_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,      -- null = self
   90 |   p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
   91 |   p_method text DEFAULT 'manual',
   92 |   p_notes text DEFAULT NULL
   93 | )
   94 | RETURNS jsonb
   95 | LANGUAGE plpgsql
   96 | SECURITY DEFINER
   97 | SET search_path = public
   98 | AS $$
   99 | DECLARE
  100 |   me record;
  101 |   target uuid;
  102 |   branch uuid;
  103 |   row_id uuid;
  104 | BEGIN
  105 |   SELECT id, role, branch_id INTO me FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid();
  106 |   IF me.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTH_SESSION_MISSING'; END IF;
  107 | 
  108 |   target := COALESCE(p_staff_id, me.id);
  109 | 
  110 |   -- Self always OK; owner/manager/super for others
  111 |   IF target IS DISTINCT FROM me.id
  112 |      AND me.role NOT IN ('super_owner', 'owner', 'branch_manager') THEN
  113 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN';
  114 |   END IF;
  115 | 
  116 |   SELECT branch_id INTO branch FROM profiles WHERE id = target;
  117 |   branch := COALESCE(p_branch_id, branch, me.branch_id);
  118 |   IF branch IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BRANCH_REQUIRED'; END IF;
  119 | 
  120 |   IF me.role IN ('owner', 'branch_manager')
  121 |      AND me.role <> 'super_owner'
  122 |      AND me.branch_id IS DISTINCT FROM branch THEN
  123 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN_BRANCH';
  124 |   END IF;
  125 | 
  126 |   IF EXISTS (
  127 |     SELECT 1 FROM staff_attendance
  128 |     WHERE staff_id = target AND checked_out_at IS NULL
  129 |   ) THEN
  130 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'ALREADY_CHECKED_IN';
  131 |   END IF;
  132 | 
  133 |   INSERT INTO staff_attendance (
  134 |     staff_id, branch_id, checked_in_at, method, notes, recorded_by
  135 |   ) VALUES (
  136 |     target,
  137 |     branch,
  138 |     now(),
  139 |     COALESCE(p_method, 'manual'),
  140 |     p_notes,
  141 |     me.id
  142 |   )
  143 |   RETURNING id INTO row_id;
  144 | 
  145 |   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  146 |     'id', row_id,
  147 |     'staff_id', target,
  148 |     'branch_id', branch,
  149 |     'checked_in_at', now()
  150 |   );
  151 | END;
  152 | $$;
  153 | 
  154 | -- RPC: staff_check_out
  155 | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_check_out(
  156 |   p_staff_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  157 |   p_notes text DEFAULT NULL
  158 | )
  159 | RETURNS jsonb
  160 | LANGUAGE plpgsql
  161 | SECURITY DEFINER
  162 | SET search_path = public
  163 | AS $$
  164 | DECLARE
  165 |   me record;
  166 |   target uuid;
  167 |   open_row staff_attendance%ROWTYPE;
  168 | BEGIN
  169 |   SELECT id, role, branch_id INTO me FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid();
  170 |   IF me.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTH_SESSION_MISSING'; END IF;
  171 | 
  172 |   target := COALESCE(p_staff_id, me.id);
  173 | 
  174 |   IF target IS DISTINCT FROM me.id
  175 |      AND me.role NOT IN ('super_owner', 'owner', 'branch_manager') THEN
  176 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN';
  177 |   END IF;
  178 | 
  179 |   SELECT * INTO open_row
  180 |   FROM staff_attendance
  181 |   WHERE staff_id = target AND checked_out_at IS NULL
  182 |   ORDER BY checked_in_at DESC
  183 |   LIMIT 1
  184 |   FOR UPDATE;
  185 | 
  186 |   IF NOT FOUND THEN
  187 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'NO_OPEN_SHIFT';
  188 |   END IF;
  189 | 
  190 |   IF me.role IN ('owner', 'branch_manager')
  191 |      AND me.role <> 'super_owner'
  192 |      AND me.branch_id IS DISTINCT FROM open_row.branch_id THEN
  193 |     RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN_BRANCH';
  194 |   END IF;
  195 | 
  196 |   UPDATE staff_attendance SET
  197 |     checked_out_at = now(),
  198 |     notes = CASE
  199 |       WHEN p_notes IS NULL THEN notes
  200 |       WHEN notes IS NULL THEN p_notes
  201 |       ELSE notes || ' | ' || p_notes
  202 |     END
  203 |   WHERE id = open_row.id;
  204 | 
  205 |   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  206 |     'id', open_row.id,
  207 |     'staff_id', target,
  208 |     'checked_in_at', open_row.checked_in_at,
  209 |     'checked_out_at', now()
  210 |   );
  211 | END;
  212 | $$;
  213 | 
  214 | GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.staff_check_in TO authenticated;
  215 | GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.staff_check_out TO authenticated;

    5 | // List of all file paths in desired logical order
    6 | function getAllFiles() {
    7 |   const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
    8 |   
    9 |   // Categorized order:
   10 |   // 1. Root configuration & entrypoints
   11 |   // 2. Server & Backend
   12 |   // 3. Types
   13 |   // 4. Lib / Core business logic
   14 |   // 5. Hooks
   15 |   // 6. Components
   16 |   // 7. Styles, Entry & Scripts
   17 |   // 8. Migrations & Public Assets
   18 |   
   19 |   const allFiles = [];
   20 |   
   21 |   function scanDir(dir) {
   22 |     const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
   23 |     for (const entry of entries) {
   24 |       const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);
   25 |       const relPath = './' + path.relative(rootDir, fullPath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
   26 |       
   27 |       if (entry.isDirectory()) {
   28 |         if (['node_modules', 'dist', '.git', '.github', '.vite'].includes(entry.name)) {
   29 |           continue;
   30 |         }
   31 |         scanDir(fullPath);
   32 |       } else if (entry.isFile()) {
   33 |         const ext = path.extname(entry.name).toLowerCase();
   34 |         const base = entry.name;
   35 |         
   36 |         // Skip binary / lock files / temporary files and generated artifacts
   37 |         if (
   38 |           ['.png', '.ico', '.svg', '.jpeg', '.jpg', '.pdf', '.lock'].includes(ext) ||
   39 |           base === 'bun.lock' ||
   40 |           base === 'package-lock.json' ||
   41 |           base.includes('entire-codebase') ||
   42 |           base.startsWith('.') ||
   43 |           dir.includes('.aistudio')
   44 |         ) {
   45 |           continue;
   46 |         }
   47 |         
   48 |         allFiles.push(relPath);
   49 |       }
   50 |     }
   51 |   }
   52 | 
   53 |   scanDir(rootDir);
   54 |   
   55 |   // Sort files logically: Root configs first, then server, types, lib, hooks, components, public/scripts/migrations
   56 |   const priority = (f) => {
   57 |     if (f === './metadata.json') return 1;
   58 |     if (f === './package.json') return 2;
   59 |     if (f === './tsconfig.json') return 3;
   60 |     if (f === './vite.config.ts') return 4;
   61 |     if (f === './index.html') return 5;
   62 |     if (f === './server.ts') return 6;
   63 |     if (f.startsWith('./src/types')) return 7;
   64 |     if (f.startsWith('./src/main.tsx')) return 8;
   65 |     if (f.startsWith('./src/App.tsx')) return 9;
   66 |     if (f.startsWith('./src/index.css')) return 10;
   67 |     if (f.startsWith('./src/lib/')) return 20;
   68 |     if (f.startsWith('./src/hooks/')) return 30;
   69 |     if (f.startsWith('./src/components/')) return 40;
   70 |     if (f.startsWith('./supabase/')) return 50;
   71 |     if (f.startsWith('./scripts/')) return 60;
   72 |     if (f.startsWith('./public/')) return 70;
   73 |     return 100;
   74 |   };
   75 |   
   76 |   allFiles.sort((a, b) => {
   77 |     const pa = priority(a);
   78 |     const pb = priority(b);
   79 |     if (pa !== pb) return pa - pb;
   80 |     return a.localeCompare(b);
   81 |   });
   82 |   
   83 |   return allFiles;
   84 | }

    6 | function getAllFiles(dir, fileList = []) {
    7 |   const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
    8 |   for (const file of files) {
    9 |     const filePath = path.join(dir, file);
   10 |     const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
   11 |     if (stat.isDirectory()) {
   12 |       if (!['node_modules', 'dist', '.git', '.github', '.vite'].includes(file)) {
   13 |         getAllFiles(filePath, fileList);
   14 |       }
   15 |     } else {
   16 |       const ext = path.extname(file).toLowerCase();
   17 |       const base = path.basename(file);
   18 |       if (
   19 |         !['.png', '.ico', '.svg', '.jpeg', '.jpg', '.pdf', '.lock'].includes(ext) &&
   20 |         file !== 'bun.lock' &&
   21 |         file !== 'package-lock.json' &&
   22 |         !base.includes('entire-codebase') &&
   23 |         !base.startsWith('.') &&
   24 |         !dir.includes('.aistudio')
   25 |       ) {
   26 |         fileList.push(filePath);
   27 |       }
   28 |     }
   29 |   }
   30 |   return fileList;
   31 | }

   35 | const priority = (f) => {
   36 |   const rel = './' + path.relative(rootDir, f).replace(/\\/g, '/');
   37 |   if (rel === './metadata.json') return 1;
   38 |   if (rel === './package.json') return 2;
   39 |   if (rel === './tsconfig.json') return 3;
   40 |   if (rel === './vite.config.ts') return 4;
   41 |   if (rel === './index.html') return 5;
   42 |   if (rel === './server.ts') return 6;
   43 |   if (rel.startsWith('./src/types')) return 7;
   44 |   if (rel.startsWith('./src/main.tsx')) return 8;
   45 |   if (rel.startsWith('./src/App.tsx')) return 9;
   46 |   if (rel.startsWith('./src/index.css')) return 10;
   47 |   if (rel.startsWith('./src/lib/')) return 20;
   48 |   if (rel.startsWith('./src/hooks/')) return 30;
   49 |   if (rel.startsWith('./src/components/')) return 40;

   50 | // A pure solid PNG generator without external deps (creates minimal valid uncompressed/raw PNG or SVG copy)
   51 | // For web standards, modern browsers accept SVG or valid PNGs. Let's create proper PNG buffers.
   52 | // Minimal valid 1x1 or raw PNG chunks or base64 placeholder PNGs.
   53 | // Let's create a minimal valid PNG with Pulse branding
   54 | function createPngBuffer(size, isMaskable = false) {
   55 |   const width = size;
   56 |   const height = size;
   57 |   
   58 |   // Create RGBA buffer
   59 |   const rawData = Buffer.alloc(height * (1 + width * 4));
   60 |   const padding = isMaskable ? Math.floor(size * 0.15) : Math.floor(size * 0.05);
   61 |   
   62 |   for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
   63 |     const rowOffset = y * (1 + width * 4);
   64 |     rawData[rowOffset] = 0; // Filter type None
   65 |     
   66 |     for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
   67 |       const pxOffset = rowOffset + 1 + x * 4;
   68 |       const dx = x - width / 2;
   69 |       const dy = y - height / 2;
   70 |       const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   71 |       
   72 |       // Background: Dark Zinc #0c0c0e
   73 |       let r = 12, g = 12, b = 14, a = 255;
   74 |       
   75 |       // Outer border / circle
   76 |       if (dist < (size / 2 - padding) && dist > (size / 2 - padding - 4)) {
   77 |         r = 239; g = 68; b = 68; // Red accent
   78 |       }
   79 |       
   80 |       // Pulse line drawing
   81 |       const normX = (x - padding) / (width - 2 * padding);
   82 |       if (normX >= 0.1 && normX <= 0.9) {
   83 |         let lineY = 0.5;
   84 |         if (normX > 0.25 && normX <= 0.35) lineY = 0.5 - (normX - 0.25) * 3;
   85 |         else if (normX > 0.35 && normX <= 0.5) lineY = 0.2 + (normX - 0.35) * 4.5;
   86 |         else if (normX > 0.5 && normX <= 0.65) lineY = 0.875 - (normX - 0.5) * 5;
   87 |         else if (normX > 0.65 && normX <= 0.75) lineY = 0.125 + (normX - 0.65) * 3.75;
   88 |         
   89 |         const targetPixelY = padding + lineY * (height - 2 * padding);
   90 |         const yDist = Math.abs(y - targetPixelY);
   91 |         if (yDist < size * 0.03) {
   92 |           r = 239; g = 68; b = 68; // Red
   93 |           if (normX > 0.45) { r = 249; g = 115; b = 22; } // Orange
   94 |           if (normX > 0.65) { r = 16; g = 185; b = 129; } // Emerald
   95 |         }
   96 |       }
   97 |       
   98 |       rawData[pxOffset] = r;
   99 |       rawData[pxOffset + 1] = g;
  100 |       rawData[pxOffset + 2] = b;
  101 |       rawData[pxOffset + 3] = a;
  102 |     }
  103 |   }
  104 |   
  105 |   const compressed = zlib.deflateSync(rawData);
  106 |   
  107 |   // Build PNG chunks
  108 |   const signature = Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]);
  109 |   
  110 |   function makeChunk(type, data) {
  111 |     const len = Buffer.alloc(4);
  112 |     len.writeUInt32BE(data.length, 0);
  113 |     const typeBuf = Buffer.from(type, 'ascii');
  114 |     const crcBuf = Buffer.alloc(4);
  115 |     const full = Buffer.concat([typeBuf, data]);
  116 |     const crc = crc32(full);
  117 |     crcBuf.writeUInt32BE(crc >>> 0, 0);
  118 |     return Buffer.concat([len, typeBuf, data, crcBuf]);
  119 |   }
  120 |   
  121 |   const ihdr = Buffer.alloc(13);
  122 |   ihdr.writeUInt32BE(width, 0);
  123 |   ihdr.writeUInt32BE(height, 4);
  124 |   ihdr[8] = 8; // Bit depth
  125 |   ihdr[9] = 6; // RGBA
  126 |   ihdr[10] = 0; // Compression
  127 |   ihdr[11] = 0; // Filter
  128 |   ihdr[12] = 0; // Interlace
  129 |   
  130 |   return Buffer.concat([
  131 |     signature,
  132 |     makeChunk('IHDR', ihdr),
  133 |     makeChunk('IDAT', compressed),
  134 |     makeChunk('IEND', Buffer.alloc(0))
  135 |   ]);
  136 | }
  137 | 
  138 | // CRC32 implementation
  139 | function crc32(buf) {
  140 |   let crc = -1;
  141 |   for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
  142 |     crc ^= buf[i];
  143 |     for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
  144 |       crc = (crc >>> 1) ^ (crc & 1 ? 0xedb88320 : 0);
  145 |     }
  146 |   }
  147 |   return (crc ^ -1) >>> 0;
  148 | }
  149 | 
  150 | async function run() {
  151 |   const buf192 = await createPngBuffer(192, false);
  152 |   const buf512 = await createPngBuffer(512, false);
  153 |   const buf512m = await createPngBuffer(512, true);
  154 |   
  155 |   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, 'icon-192.png'), buf192);
  156 |   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, 'icon-512.png'), buf512);
  157 |   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, 'icon-512-maskable.png'), buf512m);
  158 |   fs.writeFileSync(path.resolve('public/favicon.ico'), buf192);
  159 |   console.log('Icons created successfully');
  160 | }

    1 | // public/sw.js
    2 | const CACHE = 'pulse-shell-v1';
    3 | const SHELL = [
    4 |   '/',
    5 |   '/index.html',
    6 |   '/manifest.webmanifest',
    7 |   '/icons/icon-192.png',
    8 |   '/icons/icon-512.png',
    9 |   '/icons/icon-512-maskable.png',
   10 |   '/icons/icon.svg'
   11 | ];
   12 | 
   13 | self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
   14 |   event.waitUntil(
   15 |     caches.open(CACHE).then((cache) => cache.addAll(SHELL)).then(() => self.skipWaiting())
   16 |   );
   17 | });
   18 | 
   19 | self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
   20 |   event.waitUntil(
   21 |     caches.keys().then((keys) =>
   22 |       Promise.all(keys.filter((k) => k !== CACHE).map((k) => caches.delete(k)))
   23 |     ).then(() => self.clients.claim())
   24 |   );
   25 | });
   26 | 
   27 | self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
   28 |   const { request } = event;
   29 |   const url = new URL(request.url);
   30 | 
   31 |   // Always network for API, dev-server, models, Vite internals, and non-GET routes
   32 |   if (
   33 |     url.hostname.includes('supabase.co') ||
   34 |     url.pathname.startsWith('/api') ||
   35 |     url.pathname.startsWith('/v1') ||
   36 |     url.pathname.startsWith('/@') ||
   37 |     url.pathname.startsWith('/src') ||
   38 |     url.pathname.startsWith('/node_modules') ||
   39 |     url.pathname.startsWith('/functions') ||
   40 |     url.pathname.endsWith('.pdf') ||
   41 |     url.pathname.endsWith('.txt') ||
   42 |     request.method !== 'GET'
   43 |   ) {
   44 |     return; // browser default = network
   45 |   }
   46 | 
   47 |   // Navigations: network first, fallback to cached index.html
   48 |   if (request.mode === 'navigate') {
   49 |     event.respondWith(
   50 |       fetch(request)
   51 |         .then((res) => {
   52 |           if (res.ok && url.origin === self.location.origin) {
   53 |             const copy = res.clone();
   54 |             caches.open(CACHE).then((c) => c.put(request, copy)).catch(() => {});
   55 |           }
   56 |           return res;
   57 |         })
   58 |         .catch(() => caches.match('/index.html'))
   59 |     );
   60 |     return;
   61 |   }
   62 | 
   63 |   // Static assets & icons: cache first with network fallback
   64 |   event.respondWith(
   65 |     caches.match(request).then((cached) => {
   66 |       if (cached) return cached;
   67 |       return fetch(request)
   68 |         .then((res) => {
   69 |           if (res.ok && url.origin === self.location.origin) {
   70 |             const copy = res.clone();
   71 |             caches.open(CACHE).then((c) => c.put(request, copy)).catch(() => {});
   72 |           }
   73 |           return res;
   74 |         })
   75 |         .catch(() => {
   76 |           // Fallback to cached index or empty offline response without throwing
   77 |           return caches.match('/index.html').then((fallback) => {
   78 |             return fallback || new Response('Offline', { status: 503, statusText: 'Offline' });
   79 |           });
   80 |         });
   81 |     }).catch(() => {
   82 |       return new Response('Offline', { status: 503, statusText: 'Offline' });
   83 |     })
   84 |   );
   85 | });
   86 |
